entry.title: Automated Construction of FAIR Digital Object Knowledge Graphs from Flat Cultural Heritage Records

author.name: Zeyd Boukhers, Lingxiao Kong, Xenophon Zabulis, Georgios Toubekis

entry.summary: A pipeline transforming flat Europeana cultural heritage records into FAIR Digital Object-compliant knowledge graphs structured with CIDOC-CRM, giving every heritage entity a persistent identifier and machine-actionable metadata layer.

entry.title: Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting

author.name: Seyed Mohammad Hossein Hashemi, Mohsen Hooshmand, Parvin Razzaghi

entry.summary: Dual-Stream Attention is a multimodal framework for 12-week-ahead influenza forecasting that lets numerical epidemiological signals and noisy textual data condition each other through separate Transformer encoders. It demonstrates careful fusion design for lagged, loosely structured health text. Useful for public-health readiness planning.

entry.title: Why Does Robustness Reduce Superposition?

author.name: Adam Elimadi

entry.summary: Building on Gorton & Lewis (2025), this short paper gives an empirical mechanistic explanation of why adversarial training reduces superposition: adversarial training abandons non-robust features, leaving fewer total features to represent and thus less superposition.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Classification of Environmental Mitigations in Hydropower Licensing Documents

author.name: Hong-Jun Yoon, Tom Ruggles, Joanna Lee, Debjani Singh

entry.summary: This applied study tackles multi-label classification of environmental mitigation obligations in FERC hydropower documents under extreme label scarcity, where 40 of 135 categories lack any training examples. A RAG pipeline conditioning on retrieved examples succeeds where supervised BERT approaches achieve zero F1 on unseen classes.

entry.title: Class-Conditioned Gaussian Mixture Modeling for Imbalanced Time Series Quantification

author.name: Md Shahriar Kabir, Mayesha Maliha R. Mithila, Anne H. H. Ngu, Myl\`ene C. Q. Farias, Byron Gao

entry.summary: CC-GMNet-TS is a class-conditioned Gaussian mixture quantifier estimating class prevalences in unlabeled time-series bags, assigning each class its own mixture in a Transformer-extracted bounded latent space rather than sharing one mixture. It targets biosignal monitoring and activity recognition under imbalance.

entry.title: Variational Structure at the Edge of Stability

author.name: Eric Regis

entry.summary: This paper extends the recently introduced edge coupling—a functional whose critical points encode gradient descent fixed points and two-point orbits—to heavy-ball and Nesterov momentum. It connects discrete optimizers at the edge of stability to conservative discrete mechanics. The work deepens theory of why large learning rates exhibit oscillatory dynamics.

entry.title: Gated Decoupled Compositional Bandits: A Unified Theory of Contextual Bandits with Supervised-Calibrated Action Scaling and Pre-Execution Gating

author.name: Oleg Miroshnichenko

entry.summary: GDCB introduces a family of contextual bandits where actions compose a nominal arm with a supervised-calibrated context-dependent scaler and pass through a pre-execution gate that can veto or modify actions. Four structural theorems characterize the class outside existing bandit taxonomies. It unifies several decision-system patterns including gated deployment.

entry.title: SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction

author.name: Md. Rokon Islam Emon, Syed Shariar Alam Shuvo, Shahriar Siddique Ayon, Abdullah Al Mamun, Ahnaf Atef Choudhury

entry.summary: SAGE combines stability-aware graph-based ensemble feature selection with local explainability and a genetically optimized ANN to predict postpartum depression risk in a cohort of 766 women. Targets patient-level explanations and robustness under class imbalance.

entry.title: Precision-Aware Variable Bit Processing Elements for Hardware-Efficient Systolic Array Designs

author.name: Dantu Nandini Devi, Madhav Rao

entry.summary: Designs precision-aware variable-bit processing elements for weight-stationary systolic arrays, combining partial product truncation with compressors across FP32, TF32, and BF16 formats, optimized via NSGA-II. Targets hardware efficiency for deep learning matrix multiplication.

entry.title: Lightweight Multi-scale Hierarchical Anomaly Detection and Localization for Geospatial Big Data Applications at the Edge

author.name: Thomas Benton Townsend, Joshua Bean, Benjamin K Tkach, Narcisa Gabriela Pricope, Dimitrios Michael Manias

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight edge-oriented anomaly detection and localization approach for geospatial data streams using the H3 discrete global grid system with multi-scale drill-down logic, avoiding centralized processing of high-volume environmental and emergency data.

entry.title: From Exposure to Expectation: Frequency, Surprisal, and Language Across Development in Spanish

author.name: Francisco Portillo L\'opez

entry.summary: Two corpus studies of Spanish examine whether surprisal from language models predicts age of word acquisition alongside frequency and contextual diversity from child-directed speech. Frequency strongly predicts acquisition while surprisal contributes differently across model architectures.

entry.title: Industrial-Instruction: An End-to-End Framework for Building Instruction-Tuning and Benchmark Datasets from Industrial Technical Reports

author.name: Parsa Bakhtiari, Hassan Bashiri, Alireza Khalilipour, Masoud Nasiripour, Moharram Challenger

entry.summary: Contributes open QA datasets and an end-to-end pipeline building instruction-tuning and benchmark data from industrial technical reports, demonstrated on 906 Panasonic documents spanning 7,525 pages with layout-aware extraction, semantic indexing, and evidence-grounded multiple-choice QA synthesis.

entry.title: The Illusion of Control: Why Bare Classifier Inversion Silently Fails in Concept-Bottleneck Text Generation

author.name: Qi Bing, Xiaowei Shao

entry.summary: Analyzes why bare classifier inversion silently fails when synthesizing concept codes for controllable text generation, comparing inversion, reference-text encoding, and label-conditioned priors under compositional generalization, and tests Mahalanobis-type regularizations constraining codes toward encoder training distributions.

entry.title: CLSC DETR: Reliable Candidate Ranking via Cross Layer Geometric Support for UAV Small Object Detection

author.name: Junyan Lin

entry.summary: CLSC DETR improves candidate ranking in DETR-based detectors for small objects in UAV imagery by aggregating cross-layer geometric support rather than relying on single-query localization quality estimates. This addresses unreliable quality estimation when small objects have weak boundary cues.

entry.title: StereoDiffuer: Diffusion-based Progressive Geometry Modeling with Saliency Attention Perception for Stereo Matching

author.name: Bohan Li

entry.summary: StereoDiffuer is an iterative diffusion-based stereo matching framework that progressively refines disparity estimates, incorporating a Saliency Attention Perception module to extract geometric cues like boundaries, thin structures, and sharp edges. Confidence-guided saliency features address blurred edges and over-smoothed predictions in challenging regions.

entry.title: Three-Phase Scribble-Adaptive Curriculum Learning for autoPETV Grand Challenge

author.name: Libo Zhang

entry.summary: This autoPETV Grand Challenge solution segments lesions interactively in whole-body PET/CT by encoding accumulated scribbles as input channels and training a residual U-Net with a three-phase curriculum: fully automatic learning, ground-truth scribble observation, and online simulation of error-driven corrections across up to five steps.

entry.title: Targeted Iterative Filtering

author.name: Freddie {\AA}str\"om, Michael Felsberg, George Baravdish, Claes Lundstr\"om

entry.summary: Targeted Iterative Filtering derives a nonlinear diffusion scheme from linear diffusion in a value space determined by the application, showing application-driven transformed-space diffusion compares favorably with existing nonlinear denoising techniques across compression, acquisition, and medical contexts.

entry.title: Contextrast++: Robust Multi-Scale Contextual Contrastive Learning for Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Changki Sung, Hyungtae Lim, Wanhee Kim, Youngwoo Seo, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: Contextrast++ improves semantic segmentation through contextual contrastive learning with adaptive local-global fusion, pixel-to-anchor and anchor-to-anchor losses, and boundary-aware negative sampling, targeting long-tailed distributions and multi-scale context integration.

entry.title: LoViF 2026 The First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections: Methods and Results

author.name: Zewei He, Xi Tong, Yu Chen, Xingyu Liu, Xin Li, Zepeng Wang, Jiagao Hu, Fuhao Li, Yuxuan Chen, Fei Wang, Daiguo Zhou, Minmin Yi, Chuanrui Zhang, Liwen Zhang, Yeongjin Jeong, Hyunjin Cho, Jiwon Lee, Minsang Kim, Jae Woong Soh, Jin-Hui Jiang, Rong-Lin Jian, Chih-Chung Hsu, Youngjin Oh, Junhyeong Kwon, Junyoung Park, Jae Hyun Park, Sung Ju Lee, Nam Ik Cho, Vishwajeet Shukla, Himanshu Baurai, Zhiqi Zhang, Kui Jiang, Zhaocheng Yu, Runzhe Li, Dawei Fan, Hao Li, Zhanshuo Zhang, Fan Ji, Jiangmeng Li, Xiongxin Tang, Fanjiang Xu, Shangquan Sun, Anh-Kiet Duong, Petra Gomez-Kr\"amer, Jean-Michel Carozza, Ruibo Zhang, Dexiang Hong, Xinyan Liu, Shengeng Tang, Weidong Chen, Tzu-Hsuan Weng, Min-Te Sun

entry.summary: This workshop report reviews the First Challenge on Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections for autonomous driving, attracting 149 registered participants and 12 valid final submissions evaluated on the real-shot RDRF dataset, with analysis of effective approaches for composite raindrop-reflection degradation.

entry.title: SiZeUp: Fast 3D Proxy from Aerial Images via Depth Ordinal Loss

author.name: Wenjun Zhou, Yunshan Li, Qiaoyu Zhu, Weidan Xiong, Hao Zhang, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hui Huang

entry.summary: SiZeUp builds large-scale 3D urban proxy models from oblique aerial imagery using height-from-footprint extrusion optimized via an ordinal depth consistency loss against monocular depth priors through a differentiable renderer. Enables fast city-scale 3D abstraction. Practical for urban planning and simulation.

entry.title: Toward Sub-1 kB Identity-Preserving Face Compression: A Benchmark of Codecs, a Custom Learned Codec, and Studies of Resolution, Demographic Fairness, Recompression, and Adversarial Robustness

author.name: Petr Hurtik, Jakub Sochor

entry.summary: Benchmarks ten general and face-specific codecs for identity-preserving face compression under sub-1 kB budgets, introducing a custom learned codec and studying resolution, demographic fairness, recompression, and adversarial robustness. Directly relevant to biometric identity documents and constrained verification systems.

entry.title: DRAgent: Discriminative Reasoning Agent for Referring Expression Segmentation

author.name: Yujie Qi, Luyan Zhang

entry.summary: DRAgent reformulates referring expression segmentation so the MLLM acts as a discriminative selector over detector-generated candidates rather than predicting coordinates as text tokens, avoiding localization bias from serialized coordinates. A cleaner division of labor between detection and language reasoning.

entry.title: Optimize Surgical Triplet Recognition: A Knowledge-Driven Mixture-of-Experts Solution

author.name: Yiyi Zhang, Yuchen Yuan, Ying Zheng, Jialun Pei, Jinpeng Li, Zheng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: MoeCo applies knowledge-driven Mixture-of-Experts co-optimization to surgical action triplet recognition, addressing component-level and category-level optimization conflicts and incorporating domain knowledge for interpretability. From the same HKUST group as LaST, advancing context-aware robot-assisted surgery perception.

entry.title: Loopy: Seamless Video Loop Generation via Anchored Looping Shift of Positional Embedding

author.name: Haotian Dong, Wenjing Wang, Chen Li, Jing Lyu, Xin Wang, Di Lin

entry.summary: Loopy reveals that positional embeddings in DiT video models exhibit layer-varying positional control and uses the most influential anchor layer to define looping reference points, enabling seamless loop generation via anchored looping shifts. First analysis tying DiT positional structure to looping behavior.

entry.title: MIVIFI: Bridging Perspective and Fisheye Domains for Training Multi-View Fisheye Image Generation Models

author.name: Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp, Beg\"um Altunbas, Jiayi Wang, Yan Xia, Maarten Bieshaar, Xinyu Huang, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: MIVIFI introduces multi-view fisheye image generation conditioned on volumetric semantics for autonomous driving surround-view perception, proposing SyntheOcc-FE and another method to bridge perspective and fisheye domains. Addresses scarce fisheye training data for 360-degree coverage.

entry.title: Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation

author.name: Chengqun Yang, Liang Xu, Yanping Li, Fulong Liu, Jingnan Gao, Weili Zeng, Yichao Yan

entry.summary: Proposes spatiotemporally decoupled autoregressive diffusion for text-driven human motion generation, avoiding VQ information loss and whole-body latent inflexibility while adding fine-grained controllability. Addresses representation and architecture jointly.

entry.title: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy

author.name: Clea Dronne, Catharine H Clark, Xavier Loizeau, Elizabeth Miles, Peter Hoskin, Jamie R McClelland

entry.summary: Compares VAE normative modelling with image-conditioned segmentation diffusion for detecting organ-at-risk segmentation errors in head-and-neck radiotherapy CT, finding diffusion localizes subtle boundary errors more consistently via regional distance-to-agreement. Supports safer automated QA of radiotherapy contours.

entry.title: As-Rigid-As-Possible Regularization for Implicit Surfaces

author.name: Tobias Djuren, Markus Worchel, Ugo Finnendahl, Marc Alexa

entry.summary: Develops a sampling-based computation of the as-rigid-as-possible energy for deformation functions of implicit surfaces, exploiting implicit differentials for exact, efficient per-sample evaluation. Generalizes a mesh-era regularization staple to neural implicit shape optimization.

entry.title: The Setting of IMU Parameters in Kalman Filtering-based Information Fusion

author.name: Qiang Hu, Yanhua Zou, Shuaiyi Huo, Haibo Ge, Wei Ouyang

entry.summary: Details principled IMU parameter tuning within Kalman-filter sensor fusion, leveraging the relationship between Allan variance and power spectral density to formulate process uncertainty. Addresses the gap between static calibration conditions and dynamic operating environments.

entry.title: What is the effect of running-specific prostheses on long jumps? Optimization-based prediction and analysis using biomechanical models

author.name: Anna Lena Emonds, Johannes Funken, Wolfgang Potthast, Katja Mombaur

entry.summary: Builds rigid multibody biomechanical models of long jumpers with and without below-knee amputation, solving optimal control problems to compare motions and evaluate whether running-specific prosthesis spring properties facilitate longer jumps.

entry.title: Switched Turn-based Adaptive Source Seeking Strategy using Estimation and Information-driven Direction of Improvement

author.name: Shubhra Banerjee, Satadal Ghosh

entry.summary: Loop-based source-seeking strategy combining extended estimation with information-driven direction-of-improvement updates, switching turn-based behavior based on estimation uncertainty for gas leak localization and environmental monitoring.

entry.title: Where have organoids actually been useful?

author.name: Abhishaike Mahajan

entry.summary: Second essay in an organoid series cataloguing documented successes of organoid technology, from predicting chemotherapy benefit in cancer patients to stranger applications, critically assessing how accurate standard tellings are.

entry.title: Quantifying replication fidelity of unnatural base pairs using nanopore sequencing

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: Nature Communications article on quantifying replication fidelity of unnatural base pairs using nanopore sequencing; content was unavailable in the feed, limiting assessment to title-level inference.

entry.title: Composable Trust Infrastructure for Manufacturing Knowledge Graphs: Cross-System Provenance, Temporal Reasoning, and Decision Traceability

author.name: Grama Chethan

entry.summary: The paper presents a composable trust infrastructure for manufacturing knowledge graphs integrating SHACL validation, PROV-O provenance, bi-temporal versioning, and graph-native decision objects linked by shared correlation identifiers. The composition yields emergent trust properties no single capability provides alone.

entry.title: KSE-Web: An Analysis of Hybrid Retrieval and LLM-Assisted Query Expansion for Low-Resource Khmer Semantic Search

author.name: Nimol Thuon

entry.summary: KSE-Web analyzes hybrid retrieval and LLM-assisted query expansion for Khmer semantic search, contributing a cleaned corpus of 3K full-text documents and 300 manually reviewed queries with silver relevance labels. Evaluates BM25 variants, dense retrieval, and hybrid approaches for this low-resource language. Valuable resource for an understudied language.

entry.title: Improving Energy Efficiency of Oil Platforms Through Optimal Loading of Diesel Generators Using Machine Learning and Search Algorithms

author.name: Khivishta Boodhoo, Josh Plumbly, Nicholas Watson

entry.summary: Using 18 months of operational data from a Scottish offshore oil platform, this study applies ML and search algorithms to optimize diesel generator loading for energy efficiency. It shifts focus from production maximization toward consumption reduction on platforms.

entry.title: Hypergraph Embedding Indexing for Efficient Dense Vector Retrieval

author.name: Kishore Konda

entry.summary: This single-author paper proposes the Hypergraph Embedding Index, which organizes documents by combinations of highly activated latent dimensions rather than treating embeddings as indivisible points, enabling inverted-index-style candidate generation for dense retrieval. Multiple complementary hypergraphs improve coverage without combinatorial growth.

entry.title: Evaluating SAT Solver Metrics as Predictors of Human-Perceived Nonogram Difficulty

author.name: Changdao He, Yibing Ju, Jonathan Calver, Alice Gao

entry.summary: This user-study paper tests whether SAT solver metrics predict human-perceived Nonogram puzzle difficulty, collecting interaction and reported-difficulty data. Neither behavioral nor reported difficulty correlates meaningfully with solver metrics, though expertise moderates the relationship.

entry.title: ChequeMark: An Ensemble Machine Learning Framework for After-Hours Business Deposit Fraud Detection

author.name: Ann Youduo Xu, Emily Yu, Justin Leski, William Lam

entry.summary: ChequeMark combines XGBoost, Isolation Forest, and GraphSAGE into a multi-view ensemble producing client-level risk scores for after-hours business deposit cheque fraud. It exploits behavioral history and transaction graph patterns beyond static deposit-level checks. The approach addresses a concrete timing-gap fraud window in banking.

entry.title: A Momentum-Based Variance-Reduced Algorithm for Federated Multiobjective Optimization

author.name: Yong Zhao, Chunlin You, Minh N. Dao, Zai-Yun Peng

entry.summary: Proposes a momentum-based variance-reduced algorithm for federated multiobjective optimization, embedding momentum gradient estimators in local updates to improve convergence rates. Extends federated learning beyond single-objective utility maximization.

entry.title: Advanced LLM-Enhanced Intent-Based 5G Network Management using Dynamic Semantic Routes

author.name: Thomas Benton Townsend, Dimitrios Michael Manias

entry.summary: Applies dynamic semantic routing with LLMs to intent-based 5G core network management, identifying operator intents from natural-language prompts and extracting fulfillment details, with evaluation of multiple encoders for static route selection.

entry.title: GuidedFlow: An Attention-Guided Framework for Anomaly Detection in Additive Manufacturing

author.name: Sosmita Paul, Krishna Roy

entry.summary: Proposes GuidedFlow, an attention-guided normalizing-flow framework for anomaly detection in additive manufacturing, targeting tiny stringing defects that defeat existing reconstruction, embedding, and flow methods in small-data regimes.

entry.title: TSWAP: A Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Thai Wellness Advisor

author.name: Pornthep Ukosaramig, Kobkrit Viriyayudhakorn

entry.summary: TSWAP is a deployed eight-language conversational wellness advisor grounded in a verified Thai traditional-medicine knowledge base via hybrid dense-sparse retrieval with reranking, a forced first-turn retrieval classifier, and rule-based medical scope and emergency-routing safety layers, releasing a Thai retrieval benchmark with Recall@5 of 0.88.

entry.title: LongWoF-Bench: Evaluating EvoMap Genes for Verifiable Long-Workflow Tasks

author.name: Xiao Zhang, Qumeng Sun, Jihao Li, Yiming Ren, Xiang Liu, Haoyang Zhang, Junjie Wang

entry.summary: CaRGo-T represents causal and contextual relationships underlying multimodal humor as a lightweight graph serialized into code-based prompts, improving VLM comprehension of humor over linear chain-of-thought prompting.

entry.title: 3D Point Cloud from Close-Range Photogrammetry for Defect Characterisation of Rubberised Concrete

author.name: Jiacheng Liu, Mohammed Alnahhal, Ailar Hajimohammadi, Sara Gonizzi Barsanti, Jinling Wang, Mohsen Kalantari

entry.summary: This study adapts close-range photogrammetry using Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo to characterize fine-scale defects in rubberised concrete, where terrestrial laser scanning fails because laser spot size bridges microcracks. It demonstrates photogrammetric workflows can capture fine-scale defect geometry in highly tortuous sustainable materials.

entry.title: Emotion Intensity Matters: Generating Realistic Expressions in Virtual Humans with CVAEs

author.name: Vitor Miguel Xavier Peres, Lara Volpato, Gabriel Ferri Scnheider, Soraia Raupp Musse

entry.summary: This paper trains Conditional Variational Autoencoders on real human facial expression data spanning six basic emotions at two intensity levels to synthesize controllable emotional expressions for virtual humans. Despite only 7,680 training samples, the model learns meaningful latent representations preserving semantic consistency with real expressions.

entry.title: On Tensor-Based PDEs and their Corresponding Variational Formulations with Application to Color Image Denoising

author.name: Freddie {\AA}str\"om, George Baravdish, Michael Felsberg

entry.summary: This theoretical paper establishes necessary conditions for a PDE to be the Euler-Lagrange equation of an energy functional with data and smoothness terms, applying the resulting tensor-based variational formulations to color image denoising with favorable comparison to state-of-the-art techniques.

entry.title: On the Choice of Tensor Estimation for Corner Detection, Optical Flow and Denoising

author.name: Freddie {\AA}str\"om, Michael Felsberg

entry.summary: This paper shows the gradient energy tensor can substitute for the structure tensor in corner detection, optical flow, and image enhancement, enabling real-time GPU tensor-based enhancement with a 40 percent frame-rate increase at unchanged quality.

entry.title: OmicSync: Reliability-Aware Spatial Multi-Omics Clustering with Evidence-Constrained LLM Reasoning

author.name: Rabeya Tus Sadia, Qiang Ye, Qiang Cheng

entry.summary: OmicSync couples unsupervised spatial multi-omics clustering with evidence-constrained LLM reasoning that explains cluster assignments using confidence, uncertainty, and modality-routing signals. It addresses the trust and explainability gap in spatial domain discovery. Relevant to interpretable AI in computational biology.

entry.title: What Memory Composition Does Not Tell Us About Anomaly Detection

author.name: Joongwon Chae, Runming Wang, Peiwu Qin

entry.summary: Probes memory-based anomaly detectors under sparse training contamination, comparing patch selectors and introducing CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that reduces final-memory contamination to near zero. Shows global coverage selectors over-represent contamination.

entry.title: Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar

author.name: Taqi Hamoda, Nuno Gracias

entry.summary: Geometry-driven opti-acoustic co-registration using SfM-derived dense seafloor meshes as geometric anchors between optical and sonar domains, enabling view-invariant reflectivity mapping for side-scan sonar. Overcomes speckle, shadow, and viewpoint-dependence bottlenecks in underwater mapping.

entry.title: Differentiable Voxelization of Surface Representations

author.name: Tobias Djuren, Ugo Finnendahl, Markus Worchel, Hendrik Meyer, Marc Alexa

entry.summary: Derives gradients of volumetric quantities computed from winding numbers with respect to surface parameters, enabling differentiable voxelization that connects mesh optimization to grid-based volume objectives. Companion to the ARAP-for-implicit-surfaces paper from the same group.

entry.title: Design of a Human-Assistance Robot System with Contextual Action Recognition

author.name: Amanuel Ergogo, Teresa Zieli\'nska

entry.summary: Conceptual design for a proactive assistance robot combining contextual human activity recognition with behavior trees and ROS on the Spot platform, outlining how context-aware HAR improves proactive decision-making.

entry.title: Exact Finite-Length Theory of Uniform Car Parking: Spatial Laws, Absorption, and Aggregation

author.name: Ganesh P Kumar

entry.summary: Develops exact finite-length theory for the uniform car-parking process (random sequential adsorption), resolving joint densities into jamming cells evaluated by subset recursion and deriving marginals as hyperlogarithms.

entry.title: Semantic Compression Trees: Multi-Resolution Knowledge Retrieval via Hierarchical Semantic Residuals

author.name: Junaid Farooq

entry.summary: Semantic Compression Trees store hierarchical semantic residuals (information added beyond a parent node) enabling retrieval by progressive descent whose cost scales with tree depth rather than collection size. Evaluation on QASPER with bootstrap confidence intervals yields mixed results.

entry.title: Spending Scarce Confirmatory PET Measurements: Target-Aligned Validation in A4/LEARN

author.name: Eliuvish Han Cui

entry.summary: This operational study asks when simple transparent amyloid PET validation suffices versus when fitted residual-uncertainty scores justify added complexity in Alzheimer's two-stage screening workflows. It derives first-order value formulas based on target influence for spending scarce confirmatory measurements.

entry.title: Machine Learning Assisted Inverse Design of Pixelated mmWave Patch Antennas

author.name: Nadeem Rather, Holger Claussen, Lester Ho

entry.summary: This paper presents ML-assisted inverse design of pixelated mmWave patch antennas for 22-30 GHz, using XGBoost pre-screening of CST simulations to handle severe dataset imbalance where only 40 percent of random patterns resonate. The pipeline accelerates electromagnetic design search.

entry.title: When More Modalities Hurt: Modality Dropout for Heavy-Duty Vehicle Engine Diagnostics

author.name: Adeel Zafar, Slawomir Nowaczyk, Hamid Sarmadi, Saeed Gholami Shahbandi

entry.summary: Studies multimodal fusion for heavy-duty vehicle engine diagnostics across text complaints, sparse telemetry, and diagnostic trouble codes, finding naive fusion gives only modest gains over text alone. Modality dropout during training improves robustness to missing modalities.

entry.title: BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching

author.name: Joaqu\'in Figueira, Camile Lendering, Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez, Giacomo D'Amicantonio, Erkut Akdag, Egor Bondarev

entry.summary: BenthicFlow generates extensible underwater environments with a single conditional flow-matching model jointly producing aligned textures and depth maps, using MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling for large coherent scenes. Closes the surface-to-underwater data domain gap for 3D scene understanding.

entry.title: Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models

author.name: Imane Si Salah, Emile Cribelier, Thomas Veit, Wolf Hauser, Arthur Leclaire

entry.summary: SuperSharpen offers controllable blind deblurring via diffusion models with explicit restoration-strength control through a blur measure, comparing ControlNet-style adapters against full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Targets professional photography where faithfulness and realism must coexist.

entry.title: Right-Sizing LLM-Agent Decomposition in VAT Determination: A Pilot Controlled Sweep

author.name: Pedro Santos

entry.summary: This pilot controlled sweep varies only worker assignment in LLM-agent orchestration for VAT determination, comparing one wide worker to five narrow ones against a tuned single agent with a deterministic oracle. Across 4,400 runs it offers early evidence on the decomposition-versus-single-agent design debate.

entry.title: Hierarchy-Aware Semantic Losses for Knowledge Graph Link Prediction

author.name: Filip Kronstr\"om, Ross D. King

entry.summary: Evaluates hierarchy-aware semantic losses derived from box embeddings for knowledge-graph link prediction on AIFB, CoDEx, and BioKG, extending prior biological regression results. Tests whether ontological class hierarchies improve link prediction when incorporated during GNN training.

entry.title: Predicting Multiple Clinical Outcomes Related to Functional Recovery and Social Isolation Among Older Adults After Lower-Limb Fracture or Hip Replacement

author.name: Santosh Ray, Pratik K. Mishra, Ali Abedi, Charlene H. Chu, Amir Ahmad, Shehroz S. Khan

entry.summary: Predicts five interrelated clinical outcomes (functional recovery and social isolation measures) in older adults after lower-limb fracture or hip replacement using daily sensor-derived features from the MAISON-LLF dataset covering 18 participants over up to eight weeks.

entry.title: Multi-Scale Fruit Capsules: Dilated Convolutions and Dynamic Routing for In-the-Wild Explainable Fruit Recognition

author.name: Subhankar Chattoraj, Sawon Pratiher, Samiran Das, Hubert Konik

entry.summary: FruitCapsNet is a capsule network for in-the-wild fruit classification that replaces standard convolutional front ends with dilated convolutions so capsules encode multi-scale context before dynamic routing resolves part-whole agreement. It targets wide intra-class and narrow inter-class variability across fruit presentations such as bunches, peeled, bagged, or sliced states.

entry.title: WADE: A Reasoning-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Instance Floating-Waste Grounding with Compact Vision-Language Models

author.name: Md. Asaduzzaman Shuvo, Ahsan Farabi, Md. Abdul Ahad Minhaz, Mahedi Hasan, Israt Khandaker, Ibrahim Khalil Shanto, Muhammad Nomani Kabir

entry.summary: WADE introduces a reasoning-annotated benchmark for multi-instance floating-waste grounding with 2,167 rural Bangladesh images, 13,608 boxes, ten categories, and class-level recognition rules, evaluating six compact VLMs on localize-classify-count-explain tasks. Fills geographic and annotation gaps in environmental monitoring datasets.

entry.title: Bridge Damage Detection from Low-Light UAV Imagery via Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Enhancement

author.name: Hu Wang, Hongxu Pu, Zhiqi Hu, Fangzhou Lin, Wang Wang

entry.summary: DaL-MoE is a degradation-aware Mixture-of-Experts restoration front end for low-light UAV bridge damage detection, trained with ISP-aware synthesis and achieving large mAP gains (0.31 to 0.49 with YOLOv11m). Detector-agnostic design aids real inspection deployments.

entry.title: Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments

author.name: Antoni Valls, Jordi Sanchez-Riera

entry.summary: Spotter achieves real-time urban visual localization in GPS-degraded environments by geo-referencing building facades as global anchors, integrating GPS when available while remaining computationally light for edge platforms. Practical robotics/wearables positioning solution.

entry.title: What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection

author.name: Joongwon Chae, Runming Wang, Peiwu Qin

entry.summary: Companion paper arguing clean-image-only memories miss useful near-defect normal patches for anomaly detection; same CLEANCON gate and selector comparison under fixed representations and budgets. Together the pair reframes what should constitute normal references.

entry.title: MotionDLO: Hybrid Event- and Frame-Based Tracking of Deformable Linear Objects

author.name: Annalena Hartmann, Priyamvada Ajithkumar, Patrick Br\"undl, J\"org Franke

entry.summary: MotionDLO tracks deformable linear objects in real time by fusing event-camera sparsity and temporal resolution with frame-based segmentation and Coherent Point Drift under Motion Coherence Theory, achieving temporally consistent low-latency shape estimation for robot perception.

entry.title: AI Learning and Conceptual Transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules

author.name: Christo Mathew, Wentian Wang, Jacob Feldman, Lazaros K. Gallos, Paul B. Kantor, Vladimir Menkov, Hao Wang

entry.summary: A technical report on reinforcement learning agents playing the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR), covering Transformer-based A2C agents that infer hidden rules from feedback, representation design (feature- vs object-centric), transfer learning, and analysis of human learning data with pseudo-bot assistance.

entry.title: Correcting Variable Importance Scored by Random Forests

author.name: Guancheng Zhou, Haiping Xu, Jason Liu, Donghui Yan

entry.summary: Proposes correcting Random Forest variable importance by grouping correlated variables via conditional correlation structures so that masked variables regain appropriate importance scores. Targets a well-known bias affecting interpretation, selection, and cost-bounded learning. Classical ML methodology improvement.

entry.title: Multimodal examination answer data with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education rubrics for criterion-level assessment

author.name: Jahangir Alam SM, Md Khalid Syfullah, Saad Ahmed, Munira Akter Mou, A K Z Rasel Rahman, A. K. M. Masudur Rahman, Mohammed Sowket Ali

entry.summary: This data article releases a multimodal collection of 485 scanned exam answers paired with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education rubrics covering 47 criteria across nine subjects and 12 question templates. Each item links scans to criterion marks and performance-level descriptions for criterion-level assessment research.

entry.title: Statistical Machine Translation Systems of English-Pnar Language Pair : Some Insights of the Emperical Study

author.name: Edawanbiang Dhar Surmila Thokchom, Thoudam Doren Singh

entry.summary: This paper presents the first machine translation study for English-Pnar, building a 10,234-sentence parallel corpus from a regional newspaper and training phrase-based statistical MT systems under multiple configurations. Best systems achieve modest but meaningful BLEU scores for this extremely low-resource Austroasiatic language.

entry.title: Mycelial Search: A Graph-Structured Metaheuristic for Continuous Optimisation

author.name: Mohammad Mahdi Dehshibi

entry.summary: Mycelial Search introduces a graph-structured metaheuristic for continuous optimization built on active tips, Louvain-partitioned community flow, adaptive cord plasticity, and anchor-based injection. It reports competitive results on CEC 2022 benchmarks.

entry.title: Multimodal Injury Risk and Performance Prediction in Tennis Using Weighted Ensemble Learning

author.name: Weihao Qu, Dongyang Wang, Ling Zheng, Francisco E. Alvarez, Shobharani Polasa, Jiacun Wang

entry.summary: Predictive Tennis integrates wearable device readings with traditional subjective assessments in a weighted multimodal ensemble to predict athlete injury risk and performance, extending multimodal sports-analytics approaches to tennis. It addresses data-availability and subjectivity limitations of prior work.

entry.title: Large-Scale Evaluation of Advanced Imputation Methods for Missing Values in Smart Meter Data

author.name: Daniela Stojcheska, Marija Markovska, Dimitar Taskovski, Branislav Gerazov, Boris Nikolov

entry.summary: This paper empirically evaluates three imputation methods—OWA, SoftImpute low-rank completion, and a shape-modeling autoencoder—on large-scale smart meter datasets with missing values. It addresses the common lack of large-scale validation in prior imputation studies for electricity consumption data. Findings support reliable smart-grid operations such as loss detection.

entry.title: A Physics-informed Neural Network Approach for Robust Buckling Load Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Truncated Conical Shells

author.name: Devasmit Dutta, Budhaditya De, Rohan Majumder, Sudip Kumar Mishra

entry.summary: A physics-informed neural network predicts critical buckling loads of thin truncated conical shells, replacing conservative NASA knockdown factors with reliability-based design accounting for geometric imperfections and uncertainty. The framework targets aerospace and marine lightweight structures. It demonstrates PiNN value in structural engineering certification contexts.

entry.title: Poisson Subspace Clustering: Focusing on the Essentials in Count Data

author.name: Collin Leiber, Kai Puolam\"aki, Heikki Mannila

entry.summary: Presents 3CPO, a clustering algorithm for count data grounded in Poisson and negative binomial models that simultaneously identifies relevant column subsets for interpretable cluster structure. Uses iterative posterior maximization.

entry.title: Neighbor-embedded Graph Neural Network-based Crowd Delivery Traffic Management in Smart City

author.name: Kishu Gupta, Deepika Saxena, Ashutosh Kumar Singh, Chung-Nan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes NeCDM, a neighbor-embedded graph neural network system for crowd delivery traffic management in smart cities, combining congestion prediction with vehicle selection to actively reduce traffic rather than only forecast it.

entry.title: Figurative Justice: Detecting metaphors in Hindi judgements with qualitative assessment and transformers

author.name: Bhumika Bhattacharyya, Shouvik Kumar Guha, Indranil Dutta

entry.summary: Builds metaphor detection for Hindi legal judgments using transformer models plus qualitative assessment, motivated by how metaphorical framing shapes judicial interpretation and human-rights outcomes. Extends legal NLP beyond high-resource languages.

entry.title: Exploring Dowker Homology for Sentence Similarity

author.name: Marius Huber, Juri Opitz

entry.summary: Explores Dowker homology, a topological tool for relating two point clouds, as a measure of sentence similarity by treating token embeddings of sentence pairs as point clouds in transformer latent space. Shows it captures similarity information and derives practical features from it.

entry.title: Direct, Parallel, or Sequential? A Comparative Study of Training-Free Multi-Subject Image-to-Video Generation

author.name: Yanliang Qi, Kexi Chen, Muchao Ye, Haomiao Ni

entry.summary: A systematic comparative study of direct, parallel, and sequential training-free paradigms for multi-subject image-to-video generation, analyzing how decomposition affects subject preservation and motion coherence. Provides useful guidance for practitioners composing multi-subject I2V without retraining.

entry.title: A Simulator-Grounded Framework For Constructing Verifiable Muscle-Grounded QA From 3D Tongue Meshes

author.name: Seungho Eum, Unsang Park

entry.summary: Introduces a simulator-grounded framework constructing verifiable muscle-grounded QA (3DTongueQA) from ArtiSynth finite-element tongue simulations, screening ~295k configurations into ~891k QA records per language. Provides traceable biomechanical supervision unavailable in real articulatory corpora.

entry.title: Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360{\deg} Panoramic Images

author.name: Haoyi Zhong, Fang-Lue Zhang, Andrew Chalmers, Taehyun Rhee

entry.summary: Mover360 enables controllable object translation, insertion, and removal in 360-degree equirectangular panoramas via ERP-aligned instruction maps unifying point, bbox, and mask control. Addresses wrap-around and latitude-dependent distortion that break perspective editors.

entry.title: Investigating Relational Reasoning in VLMs

author.name: Adhithya Laxman Ravi Shankar Geetha, Aulia Kharis Rakhmasari, Haleema Ramzan, Xander Yap

entry.summary: Uses a synthetic geometric-shapes dataset and cue-controlled queries with Qwen3-VL-4B to show current VLMs mix genuine visual relational reasoning with shortcut strategies rooted in language cues. Adds causal-reliance testing to VLM relational-reasoning evaluation.

entry.title: The American People Really Hate Data Centers

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi analyzes why American public opinion has turned sharply against data centers, arguing the aversion mostly reflects distrust of AI, tech companies, big money, and construction generally rather than messaging failures or astroturfing.

entry.title: Physics-Knowledge-Guided Hybrid Neural Learning for Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Evolution and Short-Range Prediction

author.name: Maqun Zhang, Feng Gao, Wankun Chen, Hui Yu, Yanhai Gan, Junyu Dong

entry.summary: A position paper synthesizing lessons from two EU projects (NAMUR on LLM-supported robot control for search-and-rescue and PERSIST on persistent drone monitoring) arguing that agentic AI for safety-critical multi-drone missions must be designed around operator trust, governance, and accountability under uncertainty.

entry.title: Distinguishing Revision and Delayed Elaboration in Incremental Narrative Interpretation

author.name: Yi-Chun Chen

entry.summary: Distinguishes two update operators in incremental narrative interpretation: non-monotonic revision-driven updates that retract committed structure on contradiction, versus delayed elaboration that refines underspecified elements monotonically. Formalizes how representational state should evolve under new evidence for humans and AI processing long-form content. Conceptual framework paper.

entry.title: Minimal Local Simulation Foundations for LLM- and VLM-Driven Agents in 2D and 3D Environments

author.name: Ryuki Hyodo

entry.summary: SD-AgentFoundry provides intentionally minimal 2D and 3D simulation foundations for locally hosted LLM and VLM agents, supporting education and rapid prototyping on ordinary computers. The 2D environment includes communication and localized events; the 3D digital twin takes first-person images and produces movement instructions.

entry.title: Leveraging Remote Traffic Data for Local Air Pollutant Estimation: A Scenario-Based Machine Learning Study Across London Monitoring Sites

author.name: Valeria Legaria-Santiago, Amadeo Arguelles, Magdalena Saldana-Perez, Jocelyn Richardson, Marcella Bona

entry.summary: Evaluates four interpretable tree-based ML models under six predictor scenarios combining remote traffic data, meteorology, temporal variables, and neighboring monitoring stations to estimate air pollutants across London sites. Quantifies how much remotely acquired traffic information contributes locally.

entry.title: Motion-Based Tokenization for Cross-Dataset Egocentric Gaze Modeling

author.name: Virmarie Maquiling, Zhuojiang Cai, Enkelejda Kasneci

entry.summary: Formulates event-aligned angular displacement as an interpretable motion vocabulary for gaze representation and compares it against event-only, learned vector-quantized, and continuous encodings across datasets. Evaluates transfer, predictability, and token collapse rigorously. Advances standardized gaze tokenization for multimodal models.

entry.title: Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation

author.name: Matteo Attimonelli, Claudio Pomo, Alessandro De Bellis, Danilo Danese, Dietmar Jannach, Tommaso Di Noia

entry.summary: Introduces free-form-instruction fashion complementary image generation, enriching three CIG benchmarks with low/medium/high specificity instructions generated via LLMs, replacing rigid template prompts. Enables studying linguistic specificity effects in multimodal garment generation.

entry.title: Action-Aligned Retrieval with Pairwise Multimodal Reranking for Text-Based Person Anomaly Search

author.name: Thanh-Khoi Nguyen, Thanh-Nhan Vo, Trong-Thuan Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran

entry.summary: ActPair is a three-stage coarse-to-fine framework for text-based person anomaly search combining action-aligned multi-task VLM fine-tuning with pairwise multimodal reranking to bridge the pose-semantic gap. Improves behavior-focused person retrieval over appearance-only matching.

entry.title: SweepLSD: A One-Pass, O(width)-Memory Line Segment Detector with an Integer-Only Streaming Core and a Real-Time FPGA Realization

author.name: Yoshiyasu Shimizu

entry.summary: SweepLSD is a one-pass O(width)-memory line segment detector with integer-only streaming core and bit-exact FPGA realization detecting segments in live 1080p30 video on 2009-era silicon without frame buffers. Exceptional extreme-efficiency engineering, publishing a 2014 algorithm for the first time.

entry.title: Basins of Attraction to Multiple Fixed Points in Discrete-time Hysteresis Neural Networks

author.name: Yuta Arai, Seigo Nakamura, Ryoga Nakamura, Muzuki Ohira, Toshimichi Saito

entry.summary: Analyzes multiple fixed points and their basins of attraction in discrete-time hysteresis neural networks, introducing entropy as a measure of basin-size distribution. Shows the threshold parameter controls entropy in a binary classification setting while avoiding dimensionality issues.

entry.title: Training-Free Pseudo-Fusion for Composed Image Retrieval with Diffusion Models and Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Fan Xu, Luis A. Leiva

entry.summary: PeFuse is a training-free composed image retrieval framework leveraging pretrained diffusion models and MLLMs for pseudo-fusion of reference image and text modification queries, avoiding trained fusion modules. Demonstrates foundation-model composition can replace task-specific training.

entry.title: Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers

author.name: Contet Cl\'ement, Umberto Grandi, J\'er\^ome Mengin

entry.summary: This work provides formal abductive explanations for why candidates lose under six tournament solution rules by characterizing minimal sub-tournaments that force a loss regardless of completion. It connects computational social choice to explainable AI. Theoretically rigorous but niche.

entry.title: GAN-Diff : Coupling Pretrained WGAN-GP Features with Conditional Diffusion U-Nets

author.name: Saif Ahmed, Ashadulla Hil Galib, S. M. Riaz Rahman Antu, Ahmed Faizul Haque Dhrubo, Souvik Pramanik, Mohammad Abdul Qayum, Mohsin Sajjad, Mohammad Ashrafuzzaman Khan

entry.summary: GAN-Diff couples frozen pretrained WGAN-GP generator features into a conditional diffusion U-Net via cross-attention for image restoration tasks like denoising and 2x super-resolution on CelebA. The hybrid aims to combine GAN efficiency with diffusion restoration quality.

entry.title: Federated Ensemble Forecasting Under Supply-Chain Market Volatility

author.name: Shunmukha Sagar Puppala

entry.summary: FEF-NCL trains specialized forecasting experts across federated client nodes with negative-correlation learning to discourage redundant errors, adding drift scoring, reliability-weighted aggregation, and explainability layers for supply-chain forecasting under market volatility. Evaluation uses a single synthetic dataset of weekly SKU-region observations.

entry.title: Spectral Pre-Filtering for Context-Adaptive Sensor Fusion: A Four-Role FFT-GDCB Integration for High-Stakes Decision Systems

author.name: Oleg Miroshnichenko

entry.summary: A four-role FFT pre-filter prevents Kalman-filter covariance regression from fitting structural periodic modes rather than true uncertainty, whitening colored noise and cleaning innovations at O(N log N) cost. Positioned within the GDCB bandit framework for high-stakes sensor fusion. Practical but tightly coupled to the authors' own prior framework.

entry.title: Diversity-Based Active Learning: An Evaluation of Metric Spaces for Active Learning Selection

author.name: Siddharth Chilamkur, Dorit S. Hochbaum

entry.summary: Evaluates Greedy K-center active learning selection across multiple metric spaces including raw features, LDA projections, and learned embeddings, comparing diversity-based query strategies for label-efficient classification.

entry.title: Simplified Cross-Modal Calibration for Heterogeneous Event-RGB Stereo Systems

author.name: Nico Hessenthaler, Adam T. M\"uller, Nicolaj C. Stache

entry.summary: A motion-free calibration method for event-RGB stereo cameras using a temporally modulated blended ChArUco target on consumer displays, triggering events while staying visible to frame cameras and relaxing synchronization requirements. Simplifies a practical bottleneck for heterogeneous sensor rigs.

entry.title: ReART: Reference-Guided Retrieval and Refinement for Emotion-Aware Art Generation

author.name: Qianqian Tang, Jiayi Gao, Ting Lei, Yang Liu

entry.summary: ReART decomposes emotion-aware art generation captions into structured visual fields and performs field-wise retrieval of role-specific references over subject, layout, brush-line, and tone-mood dimensions before refinement. Grounds underspecified artistic language in perceptual detail.

entry.title: AI Safety Acculturation is Neglected

author.name: jenn

entry.summary: Argues AI safety acculturation is neglected: a culture gap separates rationalist veterans from experienced professionals pivoting into safety, and neither group's norms transmit effectively to newcomers.

entry.title: Semantic Reconstruction and 3-D Detection via Learned Multi-Pair Fusion in RF Imaging

author.name: Amir Rezaei, Wen-Xin Pan, Giuseppe Caire

entry.summary: Applies learned multi-pair fusion with a 3D U-Net over back-projection/LASSO reconstructions for semantic voxel labeling and instance grouping in anisotropic multistatic RF imaging. Bridges radio-frequency sensing and learned semantic reconstruction.

entry.title: Small Language Model enabled Autonomous agent for Language-Conditioned Cognitive Radar

author.name: Minhaj Uddin Ahmad, Zakia Zaman, Shunqiao Sun, Mizanur Rahman

entry.summary: Introduces an SLM-driven autonomous agent for language-conditioned cognitive radar that maps natural-language commands to sequences of array signal-processing tools with configured parameters. Demonstrated on synthetic uniform linear array radar. An applied example of LLM-as-controller for specialized engineering domains.

entry.title: VersaDB: A High-Performance AI Storage Database for Unifying Mutimodal Datasets

author.name: Cong Wang, Zelin Liu, Yang Luo Ran Zhang, Zhijian Guo, Hui Zhang, Fan Yu, Yanfei Cao, Naijie Gu, Jun Yu

entry.summary: VersaDB is a unified storage database designed to hold multimodal AI training datasets across formats, improving data loading throughput to keep pace with GPU/TPU/NPU acceleration. It targets data-layout bottlenecks in training pipelines. Systems-level infrastructure work rather than model research.

entry.title: Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation

author.name: YiHsuan Tsai

entry.summary: Studies spherical occupancy profiles distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D tasks, training a FiLM-conditioned profile decoder and a profile-VAE latent diffusion pipeline on Google Scanned Objects. Single-author exploratory work.

entry.title: Tolerance-Dependent Inspection Disagreement Between a Fixed CMM and a Portable Articulated-Arm CMM

author.name: Md Manjurul Ahsan, Hamidreza Samadi, Shivakumar Raman

entry.summary: Empirically examines when measurement disagreements between fixed coordinate measuring machines and portable articulated-arm CMMs cross part tolerance boundaries, using cylindrical, cubic, and spherical features at controlled temperatures. Provides guidance on instrument interchangeability decisions.

entry.title: PSA: We can do better

author.name: hersheys

entry.summary: Argues AI safety newcomers often choose work via vibes-based heuristics (conferences, pragmatic alignment) without deeply understanding core x-risk arguments, urging deeper problem comprehension before contributing.

entry.title: RIACT: A Responsible AI System for Personalized Study Habit Tracking and Early Burnout Signal Detection in University Students

author.name: Ria Sidhu

entry.summary: RIACT is a web application combining structured study-session logging with a hybrid AI architecture to give university students personalized insights and early burnout signals, addressing the retrospective nature of current burnout identification. The system emphasizes responsible-AI design principles.

entry.title: How Merge-Tolerant Are Vision Transformers for Wheat Phenotyping?

author.name: Simon Rav\'e, Pejman Rasti, David Rousseau

entry.summary: Systematic benchmark of training-free token merging (ToMe, Mutual Pair Merging) for ViTs in wheat phenotyping tasks, measuring quality-throughput-memory trade-offs including Raspberry Pi 5 edge inference. Reveals task-dependent merge tolerance hierarchies.

entry.title: HiFiC-G: Adapting HiFiC for Hi-C Contact Matrices

author.name: Andre Antonio Straton

entry.summary: Adapts HiFiC GAN-based compression loss to preserve biologically meaningful structures (loops, TAD boundaries) in Hi-C chromatin contact matrices under lossy compression, since visually acceptable compression can destroy genomic signals. Cross-domain neural codec adaptation.

entry.title: Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays

author.name: Sakshi Goel, Ayush Goyal, K S Venkatesh, Koteswar Rao Jerripothula

entry.summary: Restores missing views in light-field camera arrays via neighbor-aware generative synthesis conditioned on selected neighboring images and positional encoding maps. Handles hardware-failure scenarios in dense camera rigs.

entry.title: From Subjective Judgments to Auditable Standards:Protocol-Guided AI Auditing of Website Redundancy

author.name: Ge Kong, Yongtong Cao

entry.summary: CORA provides protocol-guided, auditable AI auditing of website redundancy, separately measuring repetition load, normal-use tax, and failure-domain recovery reserve with versioned VLM annotations, typed validation, and retained traces. Moves subjective web-quality judgments toward reproducible standards.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation

author.name: Naman Garg, Sarika Jain, George Fazekas

entry.summary: A RecSys 2026 challenge solution for conversational music recommendation using multi-modal retrieval over seven embedding spaces (CF, lyrics, audio, visual) fused with reciprocal rank fusion, followed by lightweight reranking and persona-driven generation. Primarily an engineering contribution showcasing fusion of many signals.

entry.title: Determinants of Starting Salaries for Filipino Graduates: An Explainable Machine Learning Approach

author.name: Alexander Gabriel A. Aranes, John Michael C. Magpantay, Reginald Neil C. Recario, Jamlech Iram N. Gojo Cruz, Rodolfo C. Camaclang III

entry.summary: Analyzes determinants of starting salaries for Filipino graduates using explainable ML on crowd-sourced survey data, finding job role and industry dominate over institutional prestige, corroborated by three independent lines of evidence. Applied social-science ML study addressing labor-market questions in the Philippines.

entry.title: The Axiomatic Trader: Latent Regularity, Information Budgets, and the Canonical Form of a Quantitative Investment System

author.name: Jiayu Li

entry.summary: Posits quantitative trading regularities as a time-invariant mechanism driven by an unobserved latent state, showing five declared constants force the canonical architecture of a correct investment system. Frames persistence-of-regularity as an axiom with information budgets.

entry.title: Multimodal pseudo-CT synthesis for PET attenuation correction using separate modality encoding and topogram conditioning

author.name: Rory Bell, Artemis Bouzaki, Jiaming Cao, Jasmine Morrison, Chelsea Sargeant

entry.summary: BIC-MAC Challenge submission: multimodal 3D patch-based U-Net with separate PET/MR encoders, multi-scale fusion, and FiLM topogram conditioning for pseudo-CT synthesis enabling PET attenuation correction. Reduces reliance on precise voxel-wise cross-modal correspondence.

entry.title: My AI Syllabus Policy

author.name: Vaughn Papenhausen

entry.summary: A philosophy instructor shares an AI syllabus policy arguing LLMs have shifted from calculator-analogy to personal-tutor status, laying out permitted and prohibited student and instructor uses in college education.

entry.title: CiUNet: A Hybrid Swin-CNN UNet for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Bin Dong, Jinghong Chen

entry.summary: CiUNet is a lightweight hybrid Swin-CNN UNet for medical image segmentation adding a parallel CNN encoder for local texture and bridging modules for fine-grained detail, motivated by privacy-preserving commercial deployment. Conventional hybrid architecture work.

entry.title: MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge

author.name: Liangtao Shi, Jinxia Xie, Xiantao Hu, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Third-place technical report for the MeViS-Audio track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: a training-free pipeline chaining MLLMs for text-visual correspondence with SAM-based segmentation for audio-guided video object segmentation. Demonstrates foundation-model composition for competition tasks.

entry.title: MDFI: A Multi-Domain Features Integration for Compressed Video Quality Enhancement

author.name: Sang NguyenQuang, Hieu Bui Minh, Dang BuiDinh, Xiem HoangVan

entry.summary: MDFI enhances compressed H.266/VVC video quality via a Frame-Prediction Feature Transform module and multi-domain fusion of spatiotemporal, cross-frequency, and compressed-domain prediction features. Incremental codec-enhancement research.

entry.title: Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance

author.name: Eddy Soria, Aida Valls, Ana Beatriz Hern\'andez-Lara

entry.summary: Proposes Triangular Fuzzy Rescaling Distance, a metric between triangular fuzzy numbers that integrates linear rescaling into the distance computation itself, removing the need for separate normalization of heterogeneous attributes. Includes formal proofs of metric properties. Specialized fuzzy-decision-making theory contribution.

entry.title: Quality Inspection of Printed Circuit Board Pin Insertion via Semantic Segmentation and Board-Level Feature Extraction

author.name: Nils Rabeneck, Andr\'e Kiunke, Nicole Hoess, Wolfgang Mauerer

entry.summary: Automated PCB pin-insertion defect detection combining U-Net semantic segmentation, contour feature extraction, and logistic regression board-level classification. A classical, deployable industrial inspection pipeline.

entry.title: Enhanced Artificial Neural Networks Using QHAdamW in Air Quality Forecasting

author.name: Mary Joy Daniel Vinas

entry.summary: The study combines QHAdam and AdamW into QHAdamW, an optimizer variant applied to ANN-based air quality index forecasting in the Philippines, showing improved convergence and generalization over Adam across seven evaluation metrics with tuned hyperparameters.

entry.title: Research Summary: August 24, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spans causal foundation modeling, certified LLM safety, and training/inference efficiency. Foundation Models for Partial Causal Identification extends causal FMs to bounding intervention effects under unobserved confounding, while MTCR delivers certified robustness guarantees against multi-turn jailbreaks.

  • Muon shows persistent scaling advantages over AdamW on Diffusion Transformers up to 15B parameters
  • E2-TTT derives exact closed-form state transitions for test-time training, advancing the linear-attention architecture race
  • An open-weight introspection study provides rigorous negative findings on whether LLMs can report their own internal computation
  • Optimizer-state analysis yields a causal account of subliminal trait transfer during fine-tuning
  • AI with Authority demonstrates an end-to-end AI-directed verified stack
  • Behavioral safety work shows affective context systematically amplifies LLM sycophancy
  • Self-Speculation (SSR) accelerates reasoning models training-free by drafting from partial chain-of-thought distributions
entry.content:
Today's research spans causal foundation modeling, certified LLM safety, and training/inference efficiency. Foundation Models for Partial Causal Identification extends causal FMs to bounding intervention effects under unobserved confounding, while MTCR delivers certified robustness guarantees against multi-turn jailbreaks.

  • Muon shows persistent scaling advantages over AdamW on Diffusion Transformers up to 15B parameters
  • E2-TTT derives exact closed-form state transitions for test-time training, advancing the linear-attention architecture race
  • An open-weight introspection study provides rigorous negative findings on whether LLMs can report their own internal computation
  • Optimizer-state analysis yields a causal account of subliminal trait transfer during fine-tuning
  • AI with Authority demonstrates an end-to-end AI-directed verified stack
  • Behavioral safety work shows affective context systematically amplifies LLM sycophancy
  • Self-Speculation (SSR) accelerates reasoning models training-free by drafting from partial chain-of-thought distributions

entry.title: Foundation Models for Partial Causal Identification

author.name: Alexis Bellot, Anish Dhir

entry.summary: Develops causal foundation models for bounding intervention effects and counterfactuals under unobserved confounding by defining a canonical prior with full support over structural causal models with discrete observables. The task becomes learning distributions over functions mapping data and assumptions to causal queries.

entry.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

author.name: Emilio Ferrara

entry.summary: This study tests whether open-weight language models can introspect about their own computation by intervening on residual streams, attention heads, and SAE features, then asking models what changed against sham and matched-control baselines. Across eight open-weight models from seven families, none outperformed chance, providing a negative result against claims that sufficiently capable models can audit their own internals.

entry.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence

author.name: Yang Liu, Bin Chong, Wenkai Yang, Shuai Zhang, Yancheng Chen, Feiyu Han, GuoZhen, Cheng Zhang, Huaibing Xie, Changze Lv, Shihan Dou, Pluto Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), modeling conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defining k-turn certified robustness against progressive multi-turn jailbreak attacks. It uses embedding-space mode decomposition for tighter compositional bounds and alpha-beta safety persistence to slow bound degradation.

entry.title: Scaling Muon for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Chenghao Li, Xiao Han, Xinxin Huang, Wei Liu, Boyang Li, Bing Xiao, Heran Zhang, Juanma Perez Rua, Ke Xu, Kangning Liu, Linjun Kuang, Na Li, Tan Wang, Tian Xie, Wei Peng, Yang Pei, Yifan Xu, Yuanhao Zhai, Yuwei Lin, Zhe Wang, Zihao He, Daniel Li, Junbiao Tang, Ziyang Jiang, Dake Chen

entry.summary: This work establishes Muon optimizer scaling behavior on Diffusion Transformers from 1.3B to 15B parameters, showing persistent advantages over AdamW in optimization and generative quality. To fix Newton-Schulz overhead at scale it introduces Periodic Row-wise Muon, which amortizes full spectral updates across steps.

entry.title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning

author.name: Varun Giridhar, Anant Khandelwal, Jeremy A. Collins, Ignat Georgiev, Animesh Garg

entry.summary: Q-Planning equips large visuomotor behavior-cloning robot policies with a small off-policy Q-function trained on the same demonstrations that later absorbs both successful and failed deployment rollouts, enabling self-improvement without extra human data. Because Q estimates value rather than imitating actions, failures become usable signal that BC alone cannot exploit. Avoids scaling difficulties of RL fine-tuning on multi-billion-parameter policies.

entry.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy

author.name: Fatih Deniz, Yazan Boshmaf, Dorde Popovic, Issa Khalil

entry.summary: aiXamine is a unified black-box platform evaluating LLM safety, security, and privacy as interdependent properties through 46 tests across nine services in an automated red-teaming pipeline. It surfaces cross-dimensional trade-offs invisible to siloed evaluations, such as models refusing many benign queries despite high safety scores. Produces hierarchical risk profiles for reproducible trustworthiness assessment.

entry.title: Who Delegates to AI? Evidence from 53,000 Agent Configurations

author.name: Hyeongjae Lee, Jihyang Cheon, Lanu Kim

entry.summary: Introducing delegated exposure and the Agentic Adoption Index, this study measures whether workers have actually committed tasks to AI by analyzing roughly 53,000 agent skill specifications from the Manus Skills Marketplace matched against about 18,000 O*NET task statements. It finds distinct patterns in which occupations are actually delegating work to agents, complementing capability-based exposure measures.

entry.title: Consilience: Conformally Calibrated Communication Control for Hidden-Profile Multi-Agent Reasoning

author.name: Abhijith Babu, Ramneet Kaur, Vishal Pramanik, Olivera Kotevska, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Susmit Jha, Sunny Raj, Yanzhao Wu, Sumit Kumar Jha, Anirban Roy

entry.summary: Consilience is an inference-time orchestration framework that steers and certifies communication in multi-agent LLM reasoning under hidden-profile settings where each agent holds partial evidence. It maintains a compact discussion state capturing uncertainty, disagreement, evidence gain, redundancy, and premature consensus to decide whether conversational actions are appropriate, offering guarantees absent from fixed schedules or debate protocols.

entry.title: AI with Authority, from Application to Silicon

author.name: Jason Hickey

entry.summary: Reporting that generative AI makes machine verification economical and essential rather than a cost overhead, this paper describes one researcher directing AI agents in five weeks from application code through a verified compiler and executive to a RISC-V processor taped out on a community shuttle, with no human-reviewed proofs and no human-written RTL. The Salt method rests on a hallucination-resistant proof kernel.

entry.title: Rethinking Expressivity and Efficiency in Test-Time Training

author.name: Zeyun Zhong, Joya Chen, Manuel Martin, Frederik Diederichs, Juergen Gall, Juergen Beyerer

entry.summary: E2-TTT derives a closed-form chunk-level state transition that exactly reproduces per-token fast-weight and momentum states of test-time training recurrences, enabling fully parallelized chunk-wise training without discarding temporal structure. Validated by training models up to 1.3B parameters. Balances expressivity of per-token updates with hardware-efficient chunked approximations for long-context processing.

entry.title: Move by Move: Measuring and Steering How LLMs Conduct Psychotherapy

author.name: Afonso Baldo, Hugo Pitorro, Areti Vassilopoulos, Anabela C. Areias, Maya D'Eon, Fab\'iola Costa, Ricardo Rei, Nuno M. Guerreiro

entry.summary: Introduces an ontology of ten therapeutic moves validated with five licensed psychologists and scaled via judge-based annotation, then compares human clinicians against frontier LLMs conducting psychotherapy sessions. Finds models over-use inquiry up to three times the human rate, neglect psychoeducation, and anchor strongly to strategies initiated earlier in context.

entry.title: Logic-VLA: A Temporal Logic Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Celina Shiyu Wang, Yiqi Zhao, Junjie Ye, Yue Wang, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh

entry.summary: Logic-VLA conditions vision-language-action policies on Signal Temporal Logic specifications provided at inference time, using a syntax-graph-based STL encoder pre-trained to capture temporal logic semantics. Training combines STL-conditioned supervised fine-tuning with trajectory-level preference optimization over satisfying-versus-violating rollout pairs via a flow-matching surrogate for Identity Preference Optimization.

entry.title: Self-Speculation for Faster Reasoning Models

author.name: Ravisri Valluri, Tung Nguyen, Aditya Grover

entry.summary: SSR is a training-free self-speculative decoding method that uses the partial chain-of-thought answer distribution as the draft for the model itself, exploiting reasoning-workflow structure that token-level acceleration ignores. Targets latency-sensitive interactive applications needing long reasoning traces. No auxiliary drafter model required.

entry.title: Affective Context Amplifies Sycophancy in LLM Responses

author.name: Jiayi Li, Sanjana Menon, Brett Frischmann, Shomir Wilson, Sarah Rajtmajer

entry.summary: Shows that affective context systematically amplifies LLM sycophancy: user-facing responses soften or withhold negative evaluations compared to third-party framings of identical content, measured across seven LLMs on Reddit datasets. Grounded in ingratiation theory, this reveals a consistent safety-relevant bias in emotionally loaded interactions.

entry.title: A Survey on Foundations and Frontiers of Multimodal Agentic Frameworks: Techniques and Applications

author.name: Neel Mokaria, Rishie Raj, Dheeraj Baiju, Xiaoqian Shen, Shraman Pramanick, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Arda Senocak, Mike Zheng Shou, Philip Torr, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Yapeng Tian, Ruohan Gao, Salman Khan, Sayan Nag, Sanjoy Chowdhury, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey examining how multimodality shapes agency across the core modules of agentic frameworks: perception, memory, reasoning, planning, and action. It fills a gap left by prior LLM-agent surveys by systematically covering systems built on large multimodal models processing images, audio, and video, and maps techniques to applications.

entry.title: Volumetric Radiology AI in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Zanting Ye, Shengyuan Liu, Xin Liu, Chenhui Wang, Zhisong Wang, Jiashuai Liu, Zipei Wang, Cheng Wang, Wentao Pan, Mengjie Fang, Di Dong, Mohammad Salmanpour, Arman Rahmim, Yu Gu, Yong Xia, Hongming Shan, Yixuan Yuan, Yefeng Zheng, Lijun Lu

entry.summary: This paper surveys how multimodal large language models are extending radiology AI beyond 2D image analysis toward full volumetric (3D) interpretation. It identifies a core representational mismatch between clinical needs for whole-volume spatial context and current MLLM conditioning on selected slices or report text, and outlines requirements for preserving and integrating task-relevant 3D information.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Quantum Walks based Graph Neural Network

author.name: Yuliang Zhan, Zefeng Gao, Jian Li, Yang Liu, Hao sun

entry.summary: Proposes CTQW-GNN, a graph neural network built on continuous-time quantum walks that jointly addresses heterophily and over-smoothing using properties of the CTQW propagator, with theoretical justification rather than heuristics. This offers a principled alternative to standard message passing.

entry.title: Prediction certification cannot replace explanation certification: a competence envelope for trustworthy AI under compound stress

author.name: Nataliya Shakhovska, Ivan Izonin, Stergios-Aristoteles Mitoulis

entry.summary: Proves a separation theorem showing that a reliable model and a compromised one can be identical under every prediction-side certificate (accuracy, calibration, conformal coverage) yet differ arbitrarily in explanation behavior. This establishes that prediction certification cannot substitute for explanation certification in trustworthy AI.

entry.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment

author.name: Chengxiao Wang, Enyi Jiang, Xiaojing Liao, Sanmi Koyejo

entry.summary: CLEAR proposes conditional safety adaptation where a lightweight hidden-state gate continuously controls the activation strength of a safety low-rank adapter, reducing harmful completions while leaving benign-prompt behavior of the frozen backbone intact. Experiments show improved HarmBench robustness with reduced utility degradation versus global safety tuning.

entry.title: SRL-MPC: Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control

author.name: Ruihua Han, Rui Gao, Zhe Liu, Xinyi Wang, Chang Chen, Shuai Wang, Qi Hao, Jia Pan, Hengshuang Zhao

entry.summary: Quantization-Aware Healing (QAH) recovers structurally compressed 4-bit LLMs by distilling from the bf16 checkpoint rather than refitting hard labels as in standard QAT, which converged slowly and collapsed past its peak. The recipe targets combined structural pruning plus 4-bit quantization pipelines where reasoning and coding degrade severely.

entry.title: Primal Acceleration of Newton's Method

author.name: Nikita Doikov

entry.summary: This optimization-theory paper develops a primal accelerated Newton method for convex functions with Lipschitz Hessian achieving global O(1/k^3) convergence with one linear solve per iteration and predetermined parameters. It is claimed to be the first second-order method attaining this rate without cubic regularization subproblems, nonlinear searches, or dual corrections, implementable Hessian-free.

entry.title: Designing a Robust LLM-Based Evaluation System for Agentic AI in Drug Discovery Through Human Alignment

author.name: Emma Granqvist, Roc\'io Mercado, Samuel Genheden

entry.summary: This paper presents an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework for ChatInvent, an agentic drug discovery assistant deployed at AstraZeneca, validated against human expert judgments. It defines four output-quality dimensions and shows that reference-based metrics fail for open-ended tool-augmented outputs. The work provides one of the first human-aligned validation studies of LLM judges in industrial chemistry workflows.

entry.title: Multilingual Verifier Bias in RLVR: Benchmark, Rollout Diagnosis, and the Cross-Lingual Selection Bottleneck

author.name: Chenyu Zhou, Qiliang Jiang, Xu Zhou

entry.summary: This work shows exact-match verifiers in multilingual RLVR convert format and script variation into language-dependent false-negative reward noise, breaking the assumption of language-neutral rewards. It introduces a reusable auditing protocol with verifier-robustness suites and language-conditioned reward-error metrics across Japanese, English, and Chinese, revealing sharply different rejection rates on MGSM rollouts for Qwen3 models. Identifies cross-lingual selection as a bottleneck for multilingual reasoning training.

entry.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs

author.name: Luka Ribar, Jeevan Bhoot, Douglas Orr

entry.summary: Presents a framework for quantizing vision-language models to 2.7 bits per parameter with efficient Arm CPU execution, using a self-generating-data calibration pipeline requiring no access to the original training setup. Compresses Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct to 3.7 GB with 8-bit activations while preserving strong VQA performance. Enables on-device multimodal inference.

entry.title: Truthful Calibration Measures for Sequential Prediction

author.name: Anagha Gokul, Jason Hartline, Lunjia Hu, Jonathan Ullman, Yifan Wu

entry.summary: Resolves an open question negatively: exact truthfulness is incompatible with completeness and soundness for calibration measures in sequential binary prediction, even with independent outcomes. Shows approximate truthfulness escapes the impossibility via two general reductions producing additively and multiplicatively approximately truthful measures. Advances the theory of truthful calibration following Haghtalab et al. 2024.

entry.title: EndoLIFT: Language-Disambiguated Latent-Conditioned Rectified Flow for Bidirectional Endoscopic Control

author.name: Chi Kit Ng, Yidong Zhang, Lui Siu Hing, Jinsong Lin, Tianchun Wu, Ho Yin Chim, Zhiqing Tang, Tao Yang, Huxin Gao, Trevor Yeung, Raymond Shing-Yan Tang, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: EndoLIFT is a vision-language-action policy for bidirectional gastrointestinal endoscopic control that combines language-based intent conditioning with a latent-conditioned rectified-flow action expert. It formalizes intent aliasing, where nearly identical visual observations require opposite axial actions depending on the requested procedure phase, and resolves it through explicit instruction conditioning.

entry.title: Roadside-Cooperative Autonomous Driving: From Data Platform to Vision-Language End-to-End Reasoning

author.name: Yitao Xu, Tong Wu, Yiyan Wu, Guoji Xu, Yanbo Jiang, Jiahao Wang, Zehong Ke, Junkai Jiang, Fang Zhang, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: The work introduces V2XBench, a closed-loop simulation platform with synchronized ego-roadside sensing, plus Chat-V2XBench, a progressively structured VQA dataset for cooperative driving reasoning, and proposes AURORA, an end-to-end cooperative driving framework with dual-view perception and vision-language reasoning. It targets beyond-line-of-sight perception and language-grounded supervision gaps in existing V2X benchmarks.

entry.title: CDRL: Certification-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Neutrino Flavor Model Discovery

author.name: Piyush Jha, Jake Rudolph, Victoria Knapp-P\'erez, Max Fieg, Aishik Ghosh, Vijay Ganesh

entry.summary: CDRL introduces certification-driven reinforcement learning in which symbolic reasoners produce certificates identifying which actions cause constraint violations during scientific hypothesis search.
