entry.summary: Head-to-head comparison of fine-tuned RoBERTa, TF-IDF baselines, embedding kNN, and Claude Haiku zero-shot on ATIS and CLINC150 intent detection with proper confidence intervals finds the answer depends on the intent space: fine-tuning wins by 11.8 points on ATIS while the approaches tie on the broad 150-intent schema, with three-orders-of-magnitude cost differences.

entry.title: Poly-InstructTTS: Learning In-the-Wild Expressive Speech Synthesis from Open-Ended Instructions

author.name: Junhui Zhang, Qianhui Xu, Qingxiang Guo, Dawei Yang, Ling Miao, Qiangqiang Wang, Yang Song

entry.summary: Poly-InstructTTS learns expressive speech synthesis from open-ended instructions using a 1,000-hour instruction-annotated audiovisual corpus covering over 1,000 fine-grained emotions and styles, combining attribute-based thinking tokens in a prompt-free GPT with flow matching and timbre injection from reference audio. It extends InstructTTSEval for evaluation.

entry.title: LingShu: A Large-Scale Symptom-Centric Contextualized Knowledge Graph Bridging Traditional Chinese Medicine and Modern Biomedicine

author.name: Rui Hua, Zixin Shu, Kai Chang, Dengying Yan, Jianan Xia, Hui Zhu, Shujie Song, Shurui Yang, Tongxin Wang, Yue Yin, Yu Wei, Lijuan Pei, Yunhui Hu, Hao Xu, Mingzhong Xiao, Xiaodong Li, Haibin Yu, Runshun Zhang, Wenjia Wang, Baoyan Liu, Xuezhong Zhou

entry.summary: LingShu is a symptom-centric contextualized knowledge graph with 17.33 million entity records and 39.47 million relations bridging Traditional Chinese Medicine and modern biomedicine through a shared phenotypic symptom layer. It supports syndrome-differentiation reasoning linked to molecular mechanisms.

entry.title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery

author.name: Chen Yuntong, Huang Ju, Liu Yu, Zhao Dan, Sun Mingqi, Ju Chentian, Liu Yanbing, Huang Lijiang, Zhao Guobin

entry.summary: MAESTRO is an LLM agent executing the full computational screening pipeline for metal-organic frameworks: mining literature, linking publications to crystal structures, curating a computation-ready database, and running progressively costlier screens that surfaced wet-flue-gas separation candidates from unrelated prior studies.

entry.title: Large Scale AI Grading of Handwritten Physics Assessments: Score Agreement and Olympiad Team Selection Outcomes

author.name: Praveen Pathak, Siddharth Tiwary, Charudatt Kadolkar, Vijay Singh, David Rakestraw, Shirish Pathare, Anwesh Mazumdar

entry.summary: GPT-5.5-based multimodal grading of 10,364 scanned handwritten physics pages from Olympiad and university examinations achieved close total-score agreement with official human marks after rubric-driven iteration, informing Olympiad team selection outcomes without exposure to official marks.

entry.title: Beyond End-to-End Success: Diagnosing Failures in Long-Horizon Security LLM Agents

author.name: Wei Shao, Chongzhou Fang, Zuxiong Tan, Zequan Liang, Setareh Rafatirad, Avesta Sasan, Houman Homayoun

entry.summary: A diagnostic methodology for long-horizon security LLM agents instruments tasks with checkpoints, separates pre- and post-capability-exposure failures, and applies controlled interventions to isolate upstream bottlenecks across delayed-information reuse, state reuse, strategy recovery, and decision-making families.

entry.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Chunyi Wang, Yunfei Ke, Junfeng Yang, Yun-Yun Tsai, Penghui Li

entry.summary: ARQ automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL vulnerability-detection queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized programs, exploiting disagreement between a synthesized program's actual behavior and the query verdict to expose false positives and negatives iteratively.

entry.title: CARD: Diagnosing Belief to Action Routing Failures in Vision Language Models

author.name: Souptik Kumar Majumdar, Fabian K\"ogel, Andreas Bulling

entry.summary: CARD steers VLM activations along one axis while measuring responses on a different axis, revealing via a cooperative grid-world Relay Chain benchmark that models internally represent partner beliefs but fail to route those representations into next-action predictions, leaving theory-of-mind information unused for action.

entry.title: TRACE: Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing

author.name: Wentao Yue, Tianyou Lai, Jiayu Luo, Qingyu Mao, Ziying Wang, Zhenyuan Ning, Qilei Li

entry.summary: TRACE uses structured radiology reports as privileged concept supervision during training while enabling image-only diagnosis at test time for breast ultrasound classification. Its teacher-guided concept-editing mechanism improves interpretability without requiring multimodal inputs or complete annotations at inference.

entry.title: Vibe Coding and Web Application Security: A Twin-Prompt Study

author.name: Darko Andro\v{c}ec

entry.summary: A controlled twin-prompt study generating six web applications twice each with and without appended security requirements, analyzed with static, dependency, dynamic, and manual techniques yielding 75 confirmed findings. The security-aware prompts produced fewer confirmed findings in most applications.

entry.title: CoAnchor: Robust Collaborative Perception under Spatio-Temporal Misalignment via Object-Level Anchors

author.name: Chi Li, Rui Lin, Aobo Ji, Dongzhu Xu

entry.summary: CoAnchor handles both communication delay and relative-pose noise jointly in collaborative perception via object-level anchors rather than dense BEV features, improving asynchronous multi-agent fusion for autonomous driving. Existing methods address only one side of the spatio-temporal misalignment problem.

entry.title: Trustworthy RAG: An Evaluation Agent for Detecting Misinformation and Knowledge Poisoning in Generative AI Systems

author.name: Balkrishna Giri, Md Toufique Hasan, Jussi Rasku, Muhammad Waseem, Pekka Abrahamsson

entry.summary: This middleware Evaluation Agent detects misinformation and knowledge poisoning in RAG systems by combining NLI factual verification with a five-signal poison detector and a composite Trust Index. On TruthfulQA with Llama 3.3 70B it reports 91 percent accuracy and 100 percent precision against poisoned retrievals.

entry.title: Curriculum-Aware Interpolate-then-Refine: Learned Physiological Time-Series Imputation under Realistic Missingness

author.name: Yu-Chao Huang, Haochen Zhang, Nicholas Konz, Tianlong Chen

entry.summary: CAIR explains why learned imputers lose to linear interpolation on clinical time series, identifying that gaps occur at clinically extreme values and span orders of magnitude in length. Its two-stage interpolate-then-refine framework with curriculum awareness outperforms generic imputers under realistic missingness patterns.

entry.title: TurboBias 2.0: Streaming Context-Biasing for Production-Efficient ASR Systems

author.name: Vladimir Bataev, Lilit Grigoryan, Andrei Andrusenko, Nikolay Karpov, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Boris Ginsburg

entry.summary: TurboBias 2.0 extends GPU-accelerated contextual phrase boosting for Transducer ASR with case-insensitive boosting graphs and per-stream batched decoding supporting user-specific context lists under strict latency constraints. It targets production streaming requirements often ignored by academic context-biasing methods.

entry.title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities

author.name: Anirudh Sundar, Min Chen, Divya Tadimeti, Gemma Zhang, Alice Li, Nigel Boachie Kumankumah, Pavan Uttej Ravva, Sadid Hasan, Somya Chatterjee, Pruthvi Prakash Navada, Xiao Wang, Yue Kang, Sulaiman Vesal, Larry Heck

entry.summary: Metag is a dataset for building meta-reviewing agents containing reviewer concerns, author-proposed resolutions, and manuscript diffs implementing stated changes, collected from manuscript versions before and after review-rebuttal cycles to help identify changes made during peer review.

entry.title: Bern2Edge: A Neurosymbolic Compiler for Edge Deployment via Bernstein Polynomial Networks

author.name: Malak Gamal El-Din, Yifan Zhang, Yasser Shoukry, Sitao Huang, Salma Elmalaki

entry.summary: Bern2Edge converts pretrained feed-forward networks into hardware-efficient Bernstein polynomial representations via knowledge distillation, enabling either high-fidelity LUT realization or symbolic rule extraction for edge deployment, unifying training, compression, and hardware synthesis stages.

entry.title: AgentDecarbonizer: Carbon-Aware Execution for AI Agents

author.name: Leyi Yan, Shuangning Li, Sihang Liu

entry.summary: Characterizing carbon emissions of OpenClaw agent workloads on WildClawBench, this paper finds emissions depend on token consumption, context cache reuse, and grid carbon intensity, and identifies deadline flexibility as an opportunity to schedule agent tasks into lower-carbon periods or regions.

entry.title: Hidden Axis of Uncertainty: Latent-Posterior Alignment in Graph Neural Networks with Bayesian Output Layers

author.name: Suk Hoon Choi, Damdae Park, Junhyuk Choi, Hyein Jung, Changsoo Kim, Ung Lee, Kyeongsu Kim

entry.summary: Observing that predictive uncertainty in GNNs with Bayesian output layers decreases as latent representations shift toward lower-variance posterior directions even without posterior contraction, this paper names Latent-Posterior Alignment and supports its functional role with interventional experiments, revising conventional BNN uncertainty theory.

entry.title: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xuyao Lin, Yixiang Shan, Jinru Duan, Tao Yang, Xinyu Zhao, Runyu Lei, Yiming Zhao, Jiaxin Fan, Zongbao Feng, Peng Jia

entry.summary: Argues coupled actor-critic training is poorly suited to offline RL since fixed data cannot validate critics, leading to OOD action drift and overestimation amplification; the paper decouples policy extraction from value learning to break this pathological interaction.

entry.title: Thermo-FL: Thermal-Aware Robust Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models for Edge AI

author.name: Shiva Shrestha, Kazi Shaharair Sharif, Zongxing Xie, Jiajing Huang, Anhao Xiang, Honghui Xu

entry.summary: Thermo-FL is a thermal-aware federated LoRA fine-tuning framework for edge devices that uses device temperature as an active control signal, adjusting active LoRA-layer fraction and transmitted update density based on thermal constraints. It jointly handles hardware throttling and Byzantine/adversarial update corruption. Targets realistic deployments where thermally stressed clients degrade synchronous aggregation.

entry.title: Interpretable Information-Decomposed Brain Graph Learning for fMRI-based Disease Diagnosis

author.name: Dengyi Zhao, Zhiheng Zhou, Zihan Wang, Guiying Yan, Xingqin Qi

entry.summary: IID-GCN decomposes rs-fMRI inter-regional interactions into redundancy, uniqueness, and synergy graphs using partial information decomposition, then applies interpretable graph convolution for disease diagnosis. Captures how disorders disrupt information organization beyond correlation strength. Aims at computer-aided diagnosis with mechanistic interpretability.

entry.title: Uncertainty propagation in auto-regressive random neural network models

author.name: Janice Adams, Daniele Venturi

entry.summary: Analytical and particle-based methods propagate uncertainty through random neural networks with random inputs and parameters, deriving exact local approximations for Leaky ReLU networks valid within activation-pattern-preserving perturbations. Closed-form expressions for output density, characteristic function, mean, and covariance follow, extended to autonomous dynamical settings. Bridges neural network analysis with classical uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking

author.name: Enjun Du, Siyi Liu, Zirong Chen, Xinyu Zuo, Jinwen Luo, Ruiwen Tao, Lisheng Duan, Haijin Liang, Jin Ma, Junfu Pu, Yongqi Zhang

entry.summary: EviRank recasts multimodal image re-ranking as semantic constraint satisfaction, parsing compositional queries into typed criteria across six slots labeled required, forbidden, or ignorable, forming an evidence package instead of opaque embeddings or hallucination-prone chain-of-thought. Draws on rubric-based NLP evaluation practices. Targets real queries like find this shirt in pink.

entry.title: Event-triggered Implicit Perturbation for Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Spiking Transformers

author.name: Tengteng Lei, Prabodh Katti, Rashi Dutt, Houssem Sifaou, Tan Peng, Osvaldo Simeone, Kai Xu, Bipin Rajendran

entry.summary: IPZO enables zeroth-order fine-tuning of spiking transformers on in-memory computing accelerators by computing perturbation sums in an event-triggered perturbation generation unit fused with IMC array weighted sums, eliminating expensive read-modify-write cycles and RNG hardware footprint. Suited to non-differentiable, event-driven SNNs where gradients are unavailable. Hardware-algorithm co-design for neuromorphic training.

entry.title: Using Human-LLM Disagreement to Improve Checklist-Based Quality Appraisal

author.name: Timo van der Kuil (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Bruno Messina Coimbra (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Mirjam van Zuiden (Clinical Psychology Utrecht University), Robert A. Bagheri (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Rens van de Schoot (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Klaas Dieleman (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Berend Greijn (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Stefan Houkes (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Sebastiaan Rodenhuis (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University), Elizabeth M. Grandfield (Methodology and Statistics Utrecht University)

entry.summary: Studies whether LLM assessments can approximate expert judgments on the GRoLTS quality-appraisal checklist for systematic reviews, and whether human-LLM disagreement patterns identify ambiguous checklist items for improvement. Compares LLM ratings with expert annotations across three research domains. Treats checklist design as a variable rather than fixed input.

entry.title: Sparse Token Routing in Efficient Transformers

author.name: Sai Krishna Arthanari, JaeHyeong Chang, Chengzhe Sun, Siwei Lyu

entry.summary: Tests end-to-end whether tokens truly need unequal computational effort using SEWN, a two-stream transformer routing tokens through lightweight or full-capacity paths via a learned gate. Routing yields negligible accuracy change versus parameter-matched baselines, and gate faithfulness depends critically on learning method: lexicon-seeded priors fail counterfactual tests while contextual gates separate strongly. A rigorous partially-negative result on token routing claims.

entry.title: Ontology-Driven Structural Regularization for Document-Level Relation Extraction

author.name: Laura Menotti, Stefano Marchesin, Gianmaria Silvello

entry.summary: Quantifies and enforces structural consistency in document-level relation extraction, identifying ontology-constraint violations and logical contradictions in distant supervision as overlooked noise sources in DocRED-distant that propagate to model predictions. Enforcing structural well-formedness during training reduces contradictions. Ontology-driven regularization for cheaper training data.

entry.title: ForeDreamer: A Self-Evolving Dual-Agent Memory Architecture for Future Event Prediction

author.name: Linhao Zhong, Zongze Du, Linyu Wu, Yu Bo, Hourong Li, Chenchen Jing, Hao Chen, Yuling Xi, Chunhua Shen

entry.summary: ForeDreamer transforms raw open-web evidence into structured memory before prediction, separating factual memory (question-specific evidence state) from other memory types in a self-evolving dual-agent framework for future event prediction. Distills reliable signals from noisy, redundant, incomplete web data rather than feeding raw retrieval to agents. Targets open-web forecasting tasks.

entry.title: DiffVC-ONE: Diffusion-based Generative Video Compression with One-Step Video Diffusion Transformer

author.name: Wenzhuo Ma, Zhenzhong Chen

entry.summary: DiffVC-ONE is a diffusion-based generative video codec built on a one-step Video Diffusion Transformer, combining a unified unidirectional latent compressor with single-step spatio-temporal enhancement over groups of pictures. Targets high temporal consistency at low bitrates with low inference cost.

entry.title: LoRC: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Low-Rank Collapse in Semantic Residuals

author.name: Haozhen Yan, Ruoxin Chen, Jiahui Zhan, Bo Wang, Youchang Xiao, Shouhong Ding, Liqing Zhang, Taiping Yao, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: Presents the first successful impersonation attacks against face recognition systems under high-security threshold settings, focusing on practical score-based impersonation scenarios relevant to banking and airport deployments. Demonstrates that prior medium-threshold analyses underestimate risk in stringent configurations.

entry.title: A Collaborative Multi-Modality Interaction for VLA-based End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jingtao Sun, Xiaohai He, Yike Zhang, Dong Huang, Yaonan Wang, Ajmal Mian, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: Proposes a collaborative multi-modality interaction approach for VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving, combining heterogeneous sensor interaction with multi-trajectory planning to improve interpretable reasoning and robustness in long-tail scenarios beyond visual-question-answering formulations.

entry.title: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Trajectory Tracking of Differentially Flat Fixed-Wing Aerial Systems

author.name: Nishanth Bobbili, Pratyaksh Rao, Luca Morando, Luca Masci, Giuseppe Loianno

entry.summary: This paper unifies differential-flatness-based trajectory generation with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for fixed-wing UAV trajectory tracking, adding predictive, constraint-aware control atop computationally efficient planning. A wind-aware sampling strategy embedded in the NMPC improves robustness to environmental disturbances.

entry.title: FF-MPCC: High-speed Agile Formation Flight with Model Predictive Contouring Control

author.name: Aditya Dandwate, Vit Kratky, Parakh M. Gupta, Martin Saska, Robert Penicka

entry.summary: FF-MPCC extends Model Predictive Contouring Control to decentralized agile multi-UAV formation flight along demanding trajectories, introducing a reparametrization and synchronization method for dynamic formation geometries so each UAV adapts progression along complex paths while respecting individual dynamics and maintaining formation.

entry.title: STCO: Conditional Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs

author.name: Xingxin Yang, Zhan Zhang, Juan Li

entry.summary: STCO introduces prescribed-condition operator learning for time-dependent PDEs, supplying target-time condition fields such as body motion or inflow forcing to heterogeneous neural operator backbones via a shared condition interface combining Fourier features. This enables surrogate models usable for control and optimization where future forcings are prescribed rather than inferred from observed states.

entry.title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol

author.name: Guodong Xu

entry.summary: This paper defines criterion revision in LLM agents: when a success criterion K0 accepts outcomes violating broader commitments, what observations justify attributing formation and persistent use of a revised criterion K1. It requires five non-compensatory conditions including detection, proposal emission, cross-episode transfer, and intervention sensitivity, evaluated on CMB-0.1 across twelve cases and four state-management arms.

entry.title: Generalizing Soft Tissue Deformation and Force Prediction Across Material Stiffness and Geometry

author.name: Madina Kojanazarova, Sidaty El Hadramy, Philippe C. Cattin

entry.summary: Calibrates hyperelastic constitutive models on gravity-loaded silicone beams and trains a softness-conditioned equivariant graph neural network surrogate for soft tissue deformation and force prediction that generalizes across stiffness levels and geometries for surgical simulation.

entry.title: Can Legal AI Know When It Is Wrong? And Do Students Know When It Is?

author.name: Angel Mary John, Vipin Kumar Singh, Jerrin Thomas Panachakel

entry.summary: A socio-technical audit testing consumer LLM chatbots (including ChatGPT running GPT-5.2, an established model released in late 2025) on Indian Contract Act verdicts, introducing High-Confidence Error Rate to quantify incorrect verdicts delivered with near-maximum certainty, likened to a Dunning-Kruger pattern driven by precedent overfitting.

entry.title: Clarify-Then-Search: A Clarification Benchmark for Deep Search with End-to-End Nugget Restoration

author.name: Deqiang Huang, Jingbo Zhou, Xinjiang Lu, Tong Xu, Hua Wu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Clarify-Then-Search is a benchmark built from real Baidu queries evaluating whether LLM-generated clarifying questions improve downstream deep-search utility, with 518 curated intent/underspecified query pairs and evidence-grounded nugget references produced via WebDancer runs. It enables closed-book end-to-end evaluation of clarification strategies.

entry.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib

author.name: Shane Caldwell

entry.summary: ProofJudge is an agentic LLM-as-judge system scoring Lean 4 Mathlib proof quality along five dimensions beyond kernel-checked correctness, including library leverage, automation fit, and conventions, evaluated on 218 declarations from real PRs with tool access to commit state. All six judge models aligned with human accept/reject preferences in the reported setup.

entry.title: A2DINOv3: Rethinking Multi-Modal Object Detection via Socialized Collaboration

author.name: Jiekang Feng, Zhihe Fan, Yunqi Zhu, Xinjie Yao, Yueying Zhang, Yike Gao, Ranxin Li, Guanzuo Chen

entry.summary: A2DINOv3 adapts DINOv3 vision foundation models to multi-modal object detection through a Socialized Collaboration Protocol where expert modules interact selectively rather than dense indiscriminate cross-modal fusion. It preserves pretrained representations in adverse conditions like low light.

entry.title: Keyed Provenance Watermarking with Complementary Lattice-Based Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning

author.name: Xinyun Liu, Zhi Lu, Yu Chen, Ronghua Xu

entry.summary: This federated learning framework couples keyed context-provenance watermarking using physical anchor metadata (time, location, server ID transformed via HMAC) with verifiable lattice-based zero-knowledge secure aggregation. It jointly addresses data leakage, unauthorized reuse, and malicious gradient manipulation that prior work handled separately. Claims Kerckhoffs-compliant provenance guarantees.

entry.title: MotionPhys: Detecting AI-Generated Videos via Physical Consistency of Optical-Flow Trajectories

author.name: Haojin He, Hao Tan, Zichang Tan, Ajian Liu, Jun Wan

entry.summary: MotionPhys detects AI-generated videos via physical consistency of optical-flow trajectories, observing that generated clips remain locally plausible but violate inertia, force continuity, and trajectory geometry over full actions. Offers a lightweight detector exploiting physics rather than appearance artifacts.

entry.title: Coverage-Driven Verification for Safety-by-Design in AI-Based Collision Avoidance Systems

author.name: Thomas Stefani, Johann Maximilian Christensen, Elena Hoemann, Frank K\"oster, Sven Hallerbach

entry.summary: Presents a coverage-driven verification method for AI-based collision avoidance systems in aviation, addressing EASA requirements to demonstrate representativeness and completeness of operational design domains. It structures target-distribution definition and representativeness assessment for certification.

entry.title: Six misconceptions about large language models: A minimal model and diagnostic taxonomy

author.name: Zhicheng Lin

entry.summary: A rigorous out-of-distribution evaluation of five open-source LLMs on malaria virtual screening using the Malaria-Instruct dataset shows fine-tuned domain LLMs substantially beat classical ML and few-shot frontier models, with TxGemma-9B reaching top ROC-AUC and LlaSMol-Mistral-7B best enrichment factor. Domain-specific fine-tuning proved categorically indispensable.

entry.title: JuryProbe: An Empirical Consensus-Risk Diagnostic for Routing Reference-Free Factuality Judge Panels to Grounded Verification

author.name: Tianxin Zhou, Ruixi Lin

entry.summary: JuryProbe estimates consensus risk in reference-free factuality judge panels using false-negative-only correlation and false-consensus lift from a labeled calibration probe, routing high-risk majority accepts to judges equipped with trusted references. On audited FEVER corruptions it exposes agreement reflecting shared blind spots rather than independent evidence.

entry.title: A Modular Agent for Reliable and Auditable Spatial Relation Verification in CT Scans

author.name: Simon Vincent Abel, Heiko Hillenhagen, Michael G\"otz, Timo Ropinski, Ayhan Can Erdur, Daniel Santak Wolf

entry.summary: A modular agent verifies binary spatial relations between structures in axial CT scans, addressing documented VLM weakness in controlled spatial reasoning that threatens radiological report generation reliability. Decomposing verification into auditable steps grounds spatial relations in image evidence.

entry.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter

author.name: Yunze Tong, Mushui Liu, Canyu Zhao, Shiyi Zhang, Didi Zhu, Peng Zhang, Wanggui He, Jinlong Liu, Ying Chen, Hao Jiang, Pipei Huang, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: InfinityEdit defines infinite video editing: applying edits continuously to unbounded incoming streams such as live game restyling, using a lightweight edit-ignition adapter rather than frame-aligned in-place editing over fixed spans. Opens a new streaming-editing setting.

entry.title: Masking Is Not Enough: Generative Restoration for Multimodal De-Identification in Medical AI

author.name: Shiva Shrestha, Zongxing Xie, Chen Zhao, Liran Ma, Zhipeng Cai, Honghui Xu

entry.summary: ClinX is an end-to-end multimodal PHI sanitization framework for medical image-text data, detecting visible identifiers via OCR, masking, and generative restoration, arguing masking alone leaves exploitable residue. Evaluates utility-privacy trade-offs for medical AI pipelines.

entry.title: Difficulty-Calibrated Interpolation Paths for Conditional Flow Matching

author.name: Airin Akter Tania, Md Raihan Khan

entry.summary: Difficulty-Calibrated Flow Matching adapts interpolation schedules to per-time regression difficulty measured in a pilot run, making trajectories linger where velocity is hardest to learn, improving convergence and sample quality over fixed schedules.

entry.title: Lost in Translation: How Universal Ethical Values Fail to Translate Across Global Contexts

author.name: Ozioma C. Oguine, Munachimso B. Oguine, Cesar Cervera, Jenny Yang, Pooja Voladoddi, Mario Rodriguez, Saif Eddin Bani Malhem, Karla Badillo-Urquiola, Daricia Wilkinson

entry.summary: Based on interviews with 14 experts across 10 countries, this HCI study shows that supposedly universal AI ethics values are reinterpreted through local moral logics, with privacy becoming collective and relational and transparency reframed as trust-building accountability. It documents structurally unequal deployment conditions including infrastructural constraints and extractive practices shaping risk perceptions.

entry.title: Beyond Effectiveness: A Multi-Criteria Framework for Comparing Practical Socio-Technical Interventions

author.name: Catherine King, Lynnette Hui Xian Ng, Kathleen M. Carley

entry.summary: This paper presents a multi-criteria framework for comparing socio-technical interventions (e.g., content moderation, privacy interfaces) beyond effectiveness alone, incorporating cost, effort, and feasibility. Instantiated on misinformation countermeasures via a survey of 39 researchers rating 40 interventions across five criteria.

entry.title: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming

author.name: Yibo Hu, Yu Qian, Mao Gu, Yingfan Tao, Yuhao Chen, Yongdong Luo, Zhuoqun Liu, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma

entry.summary: TLive-Omni is an omni-modal understanding model for noisy e-commerce live streams, mapping image, video, audio, and text into one representation space with Per-vGrid timestamped token organization and a three-stage training recipe progressing toward live-commerce understanding.

entry.title: Root cause analysis via difference graph discovery from linear time-series data

author.name: Anouk Ruer, Timoth\'ee Loranchet, Daria Bystrova, Charles K. Assaad

entry.summary: This paper formalizes root cause analysis for linear time-series as a difference graph discovery problem, targeting effect-defying root causes whose causal coefficients shift between normal and anomalous regimes using dynamic structural causal models. It adapts cross-population difference-graph methods to the temporal setting and validates them on simulated and real data.

entry.title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: A Systematic Analysis of Prompt Lexical Sensitivity and Its Impacts on Quality

author.name: Qipeng Xie, Zi Liang, Jiafei Wu, Yufei Chen, Weizheng Wang, Wenao Ma, Zhong Ming, Haiqin Yang, Kaishun Wu

entry.summary: Using 132,000 prompt variants, this large-scale n-gram-level analysis identifies a scaling law of prompt performance stability: higher average task performance strongly associates with lower variance under lexical perturbation. It isolates domain-specific terminology and another linguistic driver as sources of robustness.

entry.title: How to Train a Real-World Silicon Concierge? Internalizing Complex Business Workflow to Only OneModel

author.name: Chang Liu, Chaoyang Ning, Dayi Jiang, Enrui Gu, Fang Ran, Hongyan Xue, Huaqing Li, Hui Cai, Jia Liu, Jiang-Ming Yang, Jianshe Li, Jiawei Luo, Jin Zhou, Leshen Zhu, Lihui Chen, Liying Ma, Lyuxin Xue, Mengjian Ji, Ruijia Xu, Wei Ren, Wei Wu, Xiaoling Qu, Xiaoyun Feng, Xin Zhang, Xixie Zhou, Xuanwei Hu, Yan Chen, Yichao Wang, Yongqi Tong, Yu Liu, Yuhong Zhou, Zemin Sun, Zhenwen Xu, Zhiling Liu, Zifan Wang

entry.summary: OneModel consolidates complex business logic and SOPs into a single LLM via continual pretraining and logic-compilation SFT, replacing fragmented modular agent pipelines prone to cascading errors and latency in a global financial service deployment. It reports production experience internalizing workflow reasoning into unified attention space.

entry.title: ASTAR: Automated induction of STAndardized radiology Reporting templates from large-scale clinical free-text corpora

author.name: Xinfeng Zhang, Mingxuan Liu, Yifei Chen, Juncheng Zhu, Kasidit Anmahapong, Yiming Huang, Yuan Zhang, Hongjia Yang, Yi Liao, Gang Ning, Haibo Qu, Qiyuan Tian

entry.summary: ASTAR automates induction of standardized radiology reporting templates directly from large-scale free-text corpora, attacking the manual expert-consensus bottleneck upstream of template-population extraction. It enables templates that reflect real-world reporting diversity for cohort assembly and label generation.

entry.title: Ansari: A Retrieval-Grounded Islamic AI Assistant -- Architecture, Deployment, and Lessons from 140,000 Conversations

author.name: M Waleed Kadous, Amr Elsayed, Abdullah Al Nahas, Ashraf Haress

entry.summary: Ansari is a deployed retrieval-grounded Islamic AI assistant that has handled 140,000+ conversations across 25+ languages since June 2023, using a tool-using agent that searches authenticated Qur'anic, hadith, jurisprudence, and exegesis corpora and answers only from retrieved citations. It shares architecture and operational lessons on avoiding religious fabrication and value misalignment.

entry.title: One Hierarchy, Two Systems: Semantic Product IDs for Discovery-Surface Ranking and Search-Page Query Reformulation

author.name: Steven Xu, Sanjyot Thete, Saathvik Dirisala, Raghav Saboo, Nimesh Sinha, Leo Shao, Elyse Winer, Sudeep Das, Martin Wang, Kyle MacDonald

entry.summary: From an eBay-style multi-merchant catalog, a single hierarchical Semantic ID learned once from product-content embeddings supports both discovery-surface personalized ranking via prefix-aggregated affinity features and search-page query reformulation, unifying behavioral evidence fragmented across merchant-scoped identifiers.

entry.title: Do SpeechLMs Hear Their Own Opinions? Diagnosing and Mitigating Previous-Belief Contamination in Streaming Emotion Understanding

author.name: Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Ye Chen, Haonan Deng, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: On a counterfactual CREMA-D-Stream diagnostic, changing only the injected previous emotion label while holding audio fixed collapses current-audio accuracy from 72.5% to 30.4% with strongly asymmetric prior pull, revealing previous-belief contamination in streaming emotion understanding; EmoUpdate, a training-free framework separating perception from state revision, mitigates it.

entry.title: When Generated Images Look Right and Retrieve Wrong: Coverage-Guided Cross-Scale Re-Indexing for Knowledge-Faithful Generative Perception

author.name: Guangyuan Dong, Chuang Liu, Yangchen Zeng, Haoyu Wang, Xiaoyang Yu, Pinlong Zhao, Yuchao Hou, Ziwei Li, Zheng Lin

entry.summary: This paper formalizes semantic collapse, a failure where generative models drop scale-specific concepts so generated images become unretrievable by their source queries, and proposes CERES, a closed-loop indexing framework using a three-level semantic pyramid and scale-routed cross-attention. It connects generation quality directly to downstream retrieval faithfulness.

entry.title: KREL: Automatic Medical Coding via Knowledge-Guided Reasoning over Clinical Evidence with LLMs

author.name: Xubin Chen, Yipeng Zhou, Wen Sun, Chengkai Huang, Xiaoming Fu, Quan Z. Sheng

entry.summary: KREL performs automatic ICD medical coding via knowledge-guided LLM reasoning over clinical evidence, addressing extreme note length, vast label spaces, and implicit coding rules. It bridges PLM-style classification and LLM generation approaches for reimbursement and research use cases.

entry.title: Explainable Deepfake Detection with Feature-robust Augmentation and Evidence-grounded Explanation Optimization

author.name: Zhu Xu, Jiaqi Tang, Pokai Chen, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu

entry.summary: This paper improves explainable deepfake detection via feature-robust augmentation against image-quality degradation and evidence-grounded explanation optimization that reduces hallucinated or omitted manipulation evidence. It targets forensic use cases needing both accuracy and trustworthy rationales.

entry.title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation

author.name: Dimitri Staufer, David Hartmann, Ibrahim Baroud

entry.summary: PUN operationalizes plausible unknown person names with no indexed full-name evidence or ambiguity signals, providing a validated construction protocol combining Wikidata-derived components, web-enabled LLM screening, and search revalidation with a 204-participant human study. It fixes confounds in LLM evaluations of factuality, privacy leakage, and bias that conflate memorization, retrieval, and name priors.

entry.title: Faults That Fortify: CNN Adversarial Robustness via GPU Undervolting

author.name: Behnam Omidi, Ahmad Tahmasivand, Husam Alsyouri, Saba Al-Sayouri, Chongzhou Fang, Ihsen Alouani, Khaled N. Khasawneh

entry.summary: Shows GPU undervolting-induced stochastic faults act as implicit regularization during CNN training, improving adversarial robustness while lowering power, characterized at bit level across LeNet, VGG-6, and MobileNetV3 on MNIST and CIFAR-10 under standard and adversarial regimes.

entry.title: Resolution-Consistent Greedy Neural Approximation on Infinite-Dimensional Spaces

author.name: Pablo M. Bern\'a, Antonio Falc\'o, Diego Mond\'ejar

entry.summary: Develops constructive approximation guarantees for shallow networks with infinite-dimensional inputs observed through finitely many coordinates, separating error into coordinate-truncation and greedy finite-width terms with population guarantees uniform in retained resolution, extending to Hilbert-valued responses dimension-free.

entry.title: TRACE-C: Rank-Calibrated Relational Anomaly Detection for Multi-Stream Operational Telemetry

author.name: Matthew Faucher

entry.summary: TRACE-C is an auditable, rank-calibrated anomaly detector for aligned multi-stream operational telemetry, aggregating rolling residual channels (local sums, Gaussian copula dependence contrast, AR(1) innovations) via Fisher aggregation. Evaluated on Great Britain grid streams with frozen hold-outs, it ranks Storm Atiyah first among 2019 windows despite a disclosed channel artifact. Emphasizes strict priors and transparency.

entry.title: TH-GNN: Heterogeneous Temporal Graph Neural Networks for LLM-Agent Shilling Attack Detection

author.name: Shivam Swarup, Divya Prakash Shrivastava, Rakesh Thakur

entry.summary: TH-GNN detects LLM-agent shilling attacks on recommender systems using a heterogeneous temporal graph neural network with per-type attention, sinusoidal temporal encodings, and cross-modal fusion of structural user embeddings with review text semantics. Text-only detectors miss coordinated graph structure while graph-only detectors miss semantics; this combines both. Responds to LLM-generated fake reviews defeating existing defenses.

entry.title: Robust Discovery of Coarse-Grained Continuum Equations from Microscopic Dynamics

author.name: Partha Sarathi Mondal, Manav Kumar Jalan, Anish Kumar, Shradha Mishra

entry.summary: This study applies PDE-SINDy equation discovery to phase-separating systems, systematically examining sensitivity to data volume, library size, and noise. Correct equations emerge with limited data but spurious terms acquire finite selection probability, progressively suppressed as data grows. Provides practical guidance on robustness of learned continuum equations from microscopic dynamics.

entry.title: Keep Your Friends Close, and the Right Neighbours Closer: Disaster-Conditioned Kernel-Regularized Graph Attention for Building Damage Classification

author.name: Fuad Hasan, Chul Min Yeum

entry.summary: Disaster-conditioned kernel-regularized graph attention incorporates spatial neighborhood context into building damage classification on xBD, addressing that floods, hurricanes, and wildfires exhibit different clustering behavior. Naive context aggregation oversmooths boundaries and propagates errors, so the right neighborhood is event-dependent. Studies when spatial reasoning helps versus hurts post-localization classification.

entry.title: Conditional-Independence-Regularized Distributional Autoencoders for Mixed-Type Data

author.name: Siyuan Tang, Gongjun Xu, Ji Zhu

entry.summary: Conditional-independence-regularized distributional autoencoders learn low-dimensional representations of mixed numerical-categorical data via conditional distribution matching, combining energy-score objectives for continuous variables with structural regularization preserving interpretable relationships. Goes beyond reconstruction accuracy or unconditional generation toward recovering full conditional distributions. Targets scientific mixed-type datasets.

entry.title: Sharing the Control Authority Between Deep Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Control: Application to Multi-Class Transportation Networks

author.name: Giray Onur, Azita Dabiri, Bart De Schutter

entry.summary: Shares control authority between deep reinforcement learning and model predictive control for multi-class transportation networks, combining DRL adaptability with MPC constraint handling under nonlinear dynamics and high-dimensional states. Targets real-time implementation with limited compute where neither approach alone suffices. Applied to mixed vehicle-type network control.

entry.title: Training DeepFilterNet with Accurate Room Acoustic Simulations Improves Single-Channel Speech Enhancement

author.name: Alessia Milo, Georg G\"otz, Steinar Gu{\dh}j\'onsson, Daniel Gert Nielsen, Jesper Pedersen, Finnur Pind

entry.summary: Trains DeepFilterNet3 speech enhancement with higher-acoustic-fidelity room impulse responses from hybrid wave-based and geometrical acoustics simulation versus image-source-method DNS4 data, keeping the enhancement model fixed. Higher-fidelity training yields modest objective gains and substantially lower ASR word error rates on unseen measured RIRs. Quantifies the value of simulation realism for audio ML.

entry.title: From a Static Multi-Level Small Semantic Codebook to a Dynamic Single-Level Large Semantic Codebook for Generative Recommendation

author.name: Tianlu Xie, Xin Ku, Mingjie Sun, Yunhao Sha, Lixiang Wang, Peng Wang, Yiyu Wang, Wenjin Wu, Zhaojie Liu, Peng Jiang, Wenwu Ou

entry.summary: Proposes replacing multi-level residual semantic IDs in generative recommendation with a single-level large semantic codebook plus a separate collaborative disambiguation token, reducing autoregressive decoding depth and sparse hierarchical space. Adds exposure-aware dynamic updating via temporal weight decay to track shifting traffic. From an industrial recommendation team.

entry.title: ImmigrationReason: A Structured Dataset of U.S. Immigration Appeals for Legal Reasoning Research

author.name: Amirhossein Afsharrad, Seyed Shahabeddin Mousavi

entry.summary: ImmigrationReason is a structured dataset of 12,375 USCIS Administrative Appeals Office non-precedent decisions (2005-2026) capturing legal frameworks, five-category evidence-sufficiency labels, adjudicator criticism quotes, citations, and dispositions with Claude-transcribed source text. Fills the gap in legal NLP resources for administrative adjudication, where most government decisions occur. Validated via a three-pass extraction pipeline.

entry.title: ARGUS: Theory-of-Mind Guided Argument Generation with Strategy-Aware Planning and Knowledge Grounding

author.name: Zhe Hu

entry.summary: ARGUS generates persuasive arguments via an agent framework operationalizing classical rhetoric: a Theory-of-Mind reasoner builds dual mental models of audience beliefs and values conditioning a planner that assigns rhetorical functions (logos, pathos, ethos, kairos) to subtopics and triggers strategy-guided evidence grounding. Addresses audience-agnostic shortcomings of prior argument generation. Combines ToM modeling with strategy-aware planning.

entry.title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures

author.name: Lekang Jiang, Wenjun Sun, Stephan Goetz

entry.summary: Introduces Dis2Pat, a benchmark requiring generation of complete patent applications from informal inventor-style disclosures rather than structured legalistic inputs, reflecting realistic patenting workflows. Exposes that current LLMs fail at this full-pipeline task despite promising results on narrower subtasks.

entry.title: A Factorial Ablation of a Speech-to-SFT Pipeline: Differential Effects on Data Quality and Downstream Transfer

author.name: Wonsup Shin, Jingu Kim

entry.summary: Presents a 2x2 factorial ablation of a production speech-to-SFT data pipeline toggling transcript refinement and SFT data quality refinement independently, evaluated on Korean medical and finance recordings with nine fine-tuned models and multiple judge types. Provides rare public stage-by-stage attribution of marginal value in industrial data pipelines.

entry.title: ArtiMo: Agent-Driven Articulated Mesh Animation

author.name: Chunyu Zou, Peng Dai, Yi-Hua Huang, Ze Yuan, Jingwei Huang, Yeming Yao, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: ArtiMo is a zero-shot agent-driven framework for text-guided articulated mesh animation, orchestrating LLM/VLM reasoning and planning with explicit URDF kinematic constraints to satisfy causal part interactions and instruction fidelity absent task-specific training data.

entry.title: AGIDefect-4K: A Richly Annotated Dataset for AI-Generated Image Defect Detection, Localization and Explanation

author.name: Xiangfei Sheng, Weidong Zou, Tianjiao Gu, Zhichao Yang, Pengfei Chen, Leida Li

entry.summary: AGIDefect-4K provides 4,000 AI-generated images from 15 open- and closed-source models with hierarchical defect annotations spanning detection labels, pixel-level localization masks, and textual explanations. Enables comprehensive diagnosis of subtle generative defects beyond binary real/fake classification.

entry.title: Generating Multi-view Adversarial Examples for Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer

author.name: Qi Song, Ziyuan Luo, Haoliang Han, Renjie Wan

entry.summary: MVAP-G generates multi-view consistent adversarial perturbations against VGGT in a single feed-forward pass, using cross-view adversarial alignment rather than costly per-scene optimization or static universal perturbations. Reveals security vulnerabilities in feed-forward 3D reconstruction models.

entry.title: GAP-SAM: A Global Artifact Prior for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Manipulation Localization

author.name: Haozhen Yan, Siyuan Shan, Zijian Yu, Youqi Wang, Yan Hong, Jun Lan, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: GAP-SAM studies out-of-distribution generalization for AI-generated image manipulation localization, constructing COCO-ControlNet with edge/depth conditioning to disentangle forensic evidence from mask geometry, and identifying boundary adhesion as a failure mode of fine-tuned segmenters.

entry.title: Triangulation-Free Bundle Adjustment with Graduated Non-Convexity for Camera Pose Refinement from Coarse Priors

author.name: Nikolaos Kyriazis

entry.summary: Removes triangulation from bundle adjustment for camera pose refinement, assigning scalar depths along back-projected rays so accurate ARKit priors are not degraded by structure seeded from prior error; demonstrates COLMAP degrades accurate mobile AR priors on ScanNet++ captures.

entry.title: Dorsal Hand Images for Immersive (XR) and Privacy-preserving Age Assurance and Child Safety

author.name: Riccardo Bovo, George Loukas, Josh P. Davis

entry.summary: Proposes dorsal-hand imagery captured inside headsets for continuous, in-session, privacy-preserving age assurance in XR, exploiting skin properties as an alternative to impractical face-based checks. Addresses regulatory child-safety needs for extended reality platforms.

entry.title: When Adaptation Hurts: Connecting Representational Drift to OOD Failures in MedSAM Fine-Tuning

author.name: Marko Haralovi\'c, Sounic Akkaraju, Carlo Baretta, Vasil Zapryanov, Alexia Briassouli

entry.summary: Systematically examines six MedSAM adaptation strategies (LoRA variants, VPT, fine-tuning) trained on ISIC 2018 and evaluated on clean and noisy prompts across in- and out-of-distribution medical sets, connecting representational drift to OOD failures.

entry.title: Natural Sit-to-Stand Motion Synthesis For Humanoids via Guided Assistance Curricula and Staged Rewards

author.name: Meet Pal Singh, Vyankatesh Ashtekar, Ashish Dutta

entry.summary: The authors synthesize natural humanoid sit-to-stand motion from scratch using reinforcement learning without demonstrations or reference trajectories, training a single PPO policy with a coupled force/chair-height curriculum where pelvis-assist force decays as taller chairs are unlocked. Three complementary reward components drive smooth, human-like rising motions.

entry.title: Hybrid Roller-Jamming Gripper for Object Acquisition and Retention Under Pose Uncertainty

author.name: Yijie Ren, Guillaume Gourmelen, Hiroyasu Iwata

entry.summary: The hybrid roller-jamming gripper integrates active object intake (inward roller rotation drawing objects to center) with post-capture retention (vacuum-induced granular jamming stiffening the rollers) in a single device, targeting reliable acquisition under household pose uncertainty. A simplified geometric model supports the design.

entry.title: FL-MAESTRO: Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Federated Learning

author.name: Jiajun Wu, Zirui Wang, Jiayu Zhou, Qiang Ye, Steve Drew

entry.summary: FL-MAESTRO uses three specialist LLM agents coordinated together to make coupled runtime decisions in federated learning: communication topology, per-client resource allocation, and aggregation rule selection, adapting to devices dropping in and out during training. This extends prior LLM-for-FL work beyond setup-time configuration or single-dimension decisions.

entry.title: Consistency Models for Fast MRI Reconstruction Using Regularization by Denoising

author.name: Merve G\"ulle, Junno Yun, Ya\c{s}ar Utku Al\c{c}alar, Mehmet Ak\c{c}akaya

entry.summary: CM-RED embeds a pretrained consistency model into regularization-by-denoising MRI reconstruction on accelerated proximal gradients with controlled noise injection for diversity and convergence speed, mapping diffusion trajectories in a single pass to enable practical fastMRI reconstruction.

entry.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Lauren Pothuru

entry.summary: AgenticRAG-FP injects certified faults at specified hops in multi-hop agentic RAG and re-executes downstream trajectories, asking whether post-hoc traces still identify the injected hop after the suffix changes; coverage-based diagnosis reached 0.91 in a Claude Haiku 4.5 sweep on 80 MuSiQue questions.

entry.title: AffordAny: Open-World 3D Affordance Grounding from Monocular RGB Images via Vision-Language-Guided Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Junqi Wu, Kaihua Tang, Xuanwen Chen, Hongzhi Li, Jianqiang Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua

entry.summary: AffordAny grounds open-world 3D affordances from monocular RGB via a frozen VLM-guided decoder, automated text-conditioned 3D part supervision, and pseudo-label self-training, releasing a benchmark with 5,334 objects across 473 categories, an order of magnitude more diverse than prior work.

entry.title: When does fusing hand-crafted knowledge with learned representations pay? A cost-normalized benchmark of stacking, substitution, and interference

author.name: Ahmad AlMughrabi, Albert Clop, Benjamin Busam, Ricardo Marques, Petia Radeva

entry.summary: A large cost-normalized benchmark testing when fusing hand-crafted knowledge (pinned Gabor banks at ~2% overhead) with learned representations helps, is redundant, or harms, across 13 datasets, 9 backbones, and hundreds of configurations against strong data-driven alternatives.

entry.title: A VLM Answer Is Not an Anomaly Score: Rank Compression in Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Inpyo Song, Jangwon Lee

entry.summary: Argues the answer interface of VLM-based video anomaly detection (answer scale and readout rule) is part of the detector, showing probability readouts beat argmax readouts due to rank compression effects across four 7-8B VLMs on AUROC/AP-evaluated benchmarks.

entry.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs

author.name: Xianyun Sun, Chaoyou Fu, Zhengye Zhang, Feiyang Duan, Qingyuan Cao, Yonghui Niu, Sihang Yuan, Ge Zhang, Caifeng Shan

entry.summary: OmniAssistBench evaluates Omni-LLMs as proactive real-time video assistants, handling diverging interaction paths via predefined priors so static offline evaluation can approximate dynamic user-model loops. Targets interactive assistance beyond passive video QA.

entry.title: Representation Affects Retrieval: A Case Study of Skill Discovery and Routing in a Multimodal Agent Harness

author.name: Kevin Dela Rosa

entry.summary: A case study from Tinycloud, a production multimodal video agent harness, on how skill representation affects discovery and routing when an LLM planner selects among skills in context versus via embedding-based retrieval at scale. It contrasts tool-skills wrapping individual APIs against workflow-skills orchestrating multiple tools, offering practical guidance for skill library design.

entry.title: Auditable by Construction: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Trustworthy LLM Analytics in Enterprise Finance

author.name: Sergiy Lunyakin

entry.summary: KDAF argues RAG for regulated finance workflows should be evaluated on auditability alongside accuracy, using ontology-driven knowledge construction and Context-Aware Relevance Propagation so every retrieved fact carries relationship type, confidence, and source lineage. Evaluated on FinanceBench with 145 questions demonstrating traceable answers.

entry.title: Dynamic Context Scheduling: Learning Beyond the Static Universe

author.name: Martin Mr\'az, Andr\'e Biedenkapp

entry.summary: Studies dynamic context scheduling as a controlled shaping mechanism for contextual reinforcement learning, introducing DYNAMICCARLENV with pluggable schedule families. Across classic control environments, dynamic schedules match or outperform static context baselines in out-of-distribution settings.

entry.title: Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks: Encoding Anatomic Priors in Loss and Architecture, with an SE(3) Formulation of Guidewire-Induced Aortoiliac Deformation

author.name: David P. Stonko

entry.summary: AINN encodes soft anatomic priors as penalty terms in the loss and hard priors directly into the architecture so anatomically impossible predictions are excluded by construction, developed on the clinical problem of guidewire-induced aortoiliac deformation with scarce data. It draws a direct analogy to physics-informed neural networks.

entry.title: VA-DPO: Valence-Arousal Direct Preference Optimization for Controllable Emotion Generation in Language Models

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim

entry.summary: VA-DPO specifies desired affect as a continuous point in valence-arousal space and trains LoRA adapters with standard DPO against preference pairs constructed by a frozen VA regressor scoring candidate generations by distance to the target with margin filtering. It enables nuanced emotional control beyond discrete labels.

entry.title: Peer-Voted LLM-Agent Stress Tests Find Feed-Induced Lexical Convergence but No Reliable Matched-Exposure Advantage for Distributed Sources

author.name: Rana Muhammad Usman, Dominic Williamson

entry.summary: PV-SST is a preregistered peer-voted social-platform stress test across four topics, four seeds, and four open-weight model families (448 trials) finding that ranked peer-post feeds induce measurable lexical convergence among LLM agent populations, but no reliable matched-exposure advantage for distributed information sources.

entry.title: STAR-OPD: Structured Aspect-Cascade-Aware On-Policy Reward Distillation for ABSA Quadruple Extraction

author.name: Tong Sun, Mingyang Ma, Jiayang Yu

entry.summary: STAR-OPD distills large chain-of-thought models into smaller deployable ones for aspect-based sentiment quadruple extraction using on-policy reward-based distillation rather than off-policy teacher trajectories. It targets structurally invalid student states such as broken target-aspect bindings and hallucinated targets.

entry.title: CoST: Semantic-Aware Urban Understanding via Spatial-Temporal Alignment

author.name: Yutian Jiang, Jiabo Liu, Xixuan Hao, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: CoST is a contrastive spatial-temporal framework aligning satellite imagery context with multi-temporal semantics for geospatial representation learning, targeting cross-region generalization and semantic interpretability. It explicitly models spatial correlations to extract geographic regularities transferable across regions.

entry.title: Specification Portability Across LLM Development Agents: Cross-Agent Compatibility in Specification-Driven Software Migration

author.name: Oleg Grynets, Oleksii Ilchuk, Dariia Zatulna, Vasyl Lyashkevych

entry.summary: This study measures specification-first migration pipeline success on 1006 PL/SQL files converting Oracle to PostgreSQL, then tests cross-agent specification portability across Amazon Kiro, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor using Token F1, AST equivalence, and execution metrics. It probes whether specifications written for one coding agent transfer to another.

entry.title: Re$^3$Cap: Retrieval-Guided Refinement for Image Captioning Enhancement via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haonan Jia, Shichao Dong, Zenghui Sun, Jiawen Zheng, Ziqi Miao, Gege Shi, Qiuyu Zhao, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Re-cubed-Cap uses multi-modal retrieval as a reasoning signal for RL-based image captioning refinement in LVLMs, pairing a Caption Refinement Suggester and Caption Quality Assessor to identify hallucinations and omissions without additional annotations, narrowing the RL versus SFT gap.

entry.title: Time-Aware Tranformer-Based Prediction Model for AECOPD

author.name: Weihao Qu, Ling Zheng, Dongyang Wang, Jiacun Wang, Haowen Pan

entry.summary: A time-aware transformer predicts acute exacerbations of COPD using only respiratory data from home ventilators, capturing symptom temporal progression without latency-inducing lab tests. Patient representations from daily-use device data enable earlier detection. Targets home monitoring scenarios for time-sensitive clinical prediction.

entry.title: Predicting Resource Efficient Hamiltonian Decomposition for Continuous-Time Quantum Walk Simulations

author.name: Mostafa Atallah, Rebekah Herrman, Zain H. Saleem

entry.summary: Machine learning models predict whether Pauli or matching Hamiltonian decomposition yields fewer CX gates for simulating continuous-time quantum walks on graphs, trained on all 11,117 connected eight-vertex graphs. Since CX gates dominate current-hardware error, choosing the cheaper decomposition matters. Extends prior observations about sparse-versus-dense graph regimes.

entry.title: AudioWorldSim: Realistic Binaural Audio Datasets For World Models

author.name: Luis Vitor Zerkowski, Luiz Velho

entry.summary: AudioWorldSim is an open-source platform extending Meta SoundSpaces 2.0 to auto-roll out random agent navigations and generate realistic binaural audio datasets, with fixes to continuous sound composition. Released publicly for reproducibility to support audio-based world model research. A resource paper rather than a methodological advance.

entry.title: Intent Engine: Natural-Language Intent Translation for Intent-Driven Orchestration in the Compute Continuum

author.name: Koushikur Islam, Rodrigo N. Calheiros

entry.summary: Intent Engine translates natural-language intents into validated SLO artifacts for compute-continuum service placement, guarding against unsupported constraints, incorrect grounded values, and schema violations that break downstream orchestration. Architecture validates before placement logic consumes the artifacts. Reduces misconfiguration risk versus users writing metric-level SLOs directly.

entry.title: Directional Contextual Representations for Dependency Relations: Why Cross-Direction Pairing Fails

author.name: Sai Krishna Arthanari, JaeHyeong Chang, Chengzhe Sun, Siwei Lyu

entry.summary: Shows that splitting bidirectional LSTM representations into strictly forward and backward halves beats either alone and fused attention for dependency relation classification, but cross-direction pairing of forward state against candidate backward state consistently underperforms same-direction pairing with penalties growing with distance. Uses frozen-trunk diagnostics ruling out architectural leakage. Explains why a natural extension fails.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Color Image Manipulation Localization via Noise Residual Artifact Pattern Analysis

author.name: Edgar Gonzalez-Fernandez

entry.summary: A zero-shot, training-free pipeline localizes color image manipulations by estimating a device-specific reference artifact pattern from the noise residual of a single suspect image, exploiting demosaicing traces without device enrollment. Avoids assumptions about filter configuration or color layout.

entry.title: RECOUNT: Reference-guided Counting with Synthetic Visual Exemplars

author.name: Adriano D'Alessandro, Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Ghassan Hamarneh

entry.summary: RECOUNT enables image-guided zero-shot counting by specifying categories visually from a single off-scene reference image instead of text prompts, augmenting coverage with synthetic exemplar generation repurposed from generative models. Resolves the trade-off between text-guided localization strength and few-shot categorization precision.

entry.title: Aristotelian Manifolds: Leveraging Platonic Perceptual Features for Backpropagation Free Rapid Concept Learning

author.name: Michael Karnes, Alper Yilmaz

entry.summary: Formalizes Aristotelian Manifolds atop the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, mapping layer-wise how knowledge synthesizes in latent subspaces of foundation models across architectures and domains. Reveals non-monotonic, domain-distinct geometric maturation profiles.

entry.title: VisTa3D: A Dataset and Benchmark for Thin Object Reconstruction from Vision, Tactile, and 3D Point Clouds

author.name: Shania Guo, Yeongsik Seo, Andrew Fu, Mei Hao, Iris Xia, Jiwon Jenny Lee, Xinyi Mary Xie, Hyoungseob Park, Aaron Dollar, Alex Wong

entry.summary: VisTa3D is the first dataset pairing synchronized RGB, depth, tactile response maps, inertial measurements, and laser-scanned ground truth focused on thin objects, where visual and point-cloud reconstruction fails. Tests whether tactile signals aid recovery of thin structures.

entry.title: M2Depth: Unifying Monocular Depth Foundation Priors with Multi-View Stereo

author.name: Byeonggwon Lee, Sanggi Lee, Siwoo Lee, Khang Truong Giang, Soohwan Song

entry.summary: M2Depth tightly couples monocular depth foundation priors with cascade multi-view stereo via bidirectional mutual refinement: MVS resolves scale ambiguity of monocular predictions while monocular context fills occluded and low-overlap regions. Improves generalization to unseen scenes.

entry.title: Routing Before Looking: Query-Adaptive Evidence Acquisition for Long-form Video Understanding

author.name: Tianyue Wang, Xuying Wu, Yuxiang Ma, Ruiming Liang, Jiaxuan Kang, Yanchao Hao, Zheng Wei, Leigang Qu, Haiyun Guo, Jinqiao Wang

entry.summary: Route2Look provides query-adaptive evidence acquisition for long-form video understanding via a Route-Look-Memorize loop choosing among global browsing, temporal grounding, and semantic retrieval based on query demands, overcoming single-strategy limitations of prior planning-before-perception agents.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Traffic Sign Detection with Semantic Attributes for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Meda Lazar, Sourab Sridhar, Shashwata Gupta, Alexandra Tripcea, Varun Ravi, Senthil Yogamani

entry.summary: Addresses robust long-range, region-agnostic traffic sign detection for autonomous driving using multi-modal inputs and semantic attributes, tackling cross-country generalization, tiny-object detection at 200m ranges, and temporal tracking under extreme perspective distortion.

entry.title: EmotionDialogCN: A Spontaneous Multimodal Dataset for Mandarin Emotional Dialogue

author.name: Yi Zheng, Yifan Xu, Yan Zhou, Hejia Chen, Chunyu Qiang, Xiaoqiang Liu, Xiaohan Li, Shenze Huang, Yue Zhang, Guoying Zhao, Pengfei Wan

entry.summary: EmotionDialogCN is a large-scale Mandarin audiovisual emotional dialogue dataset: 21,880 sessions by 119 professional actors across 20 scenarios and 18 emotion categories with over 400 hours, collected with minimized equipment interference for natural expressions. Largest resource of its kind.

entry.title: Recognition-Conditioned Reasoning: A Training-Free Multimodal-LLM Pipeline for Fine-Grained Micro-Action Understanding

author.name: Fengshun Wang, Jin'ang Han, Zhigang Tu

entry.summary: A training-free, prompt-only MLLM pipeline that won first place in the MAC 2026 Micro-Action Challenge fine-grained understanding track, dynamically routing eight subtasks across frozen multimodal LLMs with recognition-conditioned reasoning describing body-part movements and justifications.

entry.title: Stream3Dv2: Geometric-Semantic Fusion Enhanced Streaming Zero-Shot 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Jie Xu, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Stream3Dv2 is a training-free framework for streaming zero-shot 3D scene understanding from RGB-D, using nested local-to-historical architecture for multi-view consistency with low overhead, and robustness mechanisms against noisy 2D segmentation masks.

entry.title: Frozen CLIP Priors for Robust Self-Supervised Poisson Inverse Problems

author.name: Laura C. Diaz-Delgado, Emmanuel Martinez, Henry Arguello

entry.summary: Builds an ADMM-inspired unrolled plug-and-play solver for Poisson inverse problems using frozen CLIP features as distortion-robust priors, targeting photon-limited imaging where clean ground truth is unavailable and stability under acquisition shifts is essential.

entry.title: Sparse Light Field Sampling Improves Casual 3D and 4D Reconstruction

author.name: Shamus Li, Ruiming Cao, Laura Waller, Kristina Monakhova, Sara Fridovich-Keil

entry.summary: Analyzes sensor-limited and exposure-limited multi-view capture on commodity devices, releasing a dataset spanning three camera types and evaluating sparse-view 3DGS and 4DGS baselines, questioning why pipelines default to monocular streams.

entry.title: Demonstration-Guided Humanoid Stand-Up on an Emulated Deformable Surface

author.name: Aniruddh Kushwah, Vyankatesh Ashtekar, Ashish Dutta

entry.summary: A reference-guided reinforcement learning framework generates stand-up motion for a 29-DOF Unitree G1 humanoid on emulated deformable soft ground, adapting MuJoCo soft-contact parameters (solref/solimp) across a training curriculum from hard ground downward in stiffness. Rewards combine residual joint-position tracking of a human demonstration with explicit recovery objectives.

entry.title: Deep Learning Models Also Recall Features

author.name: Pierre Beckmann

entry.summary: Generalizes mechanistic interpretability findings on factual recall into a broader concept of feature recall, arguing a linear projection can be read as retrieving stored information scaled by input activations across architectures, contrasted with feature combination. It also sketches how recall might be identified mechanistically.

entry.title: Unified Branch-and-Bound Search for the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem on Graphs of Convex Sets

author.name: Jingtao Tang, Hang Ma

entry.summary: The paper formalizes the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem on Graphs of Convex Sets and proposes a unified branch-and-bound search over rooted walk prefixes with additive lower-bound costs and cut-separated connected-flow relaxations. It proves finite termination guarantees for best-first traversal under positive-cost assumptions.

entry.title: Towards Traffic Modelling of Multi-Agent Systems: The Role of Coordination Topology

author.name: Davide Lamagna, Albert Cabellos, Alberto Rodriguez-Natal, G\'abor R\'etv\'ari, Berta Serracanta

entry.summary: A perspective proposing a minimal working model of LLM systems built on four distinctions (pretraining vs deployed, learned distribution vs samples, etc.) to defuse folk theories ranging from stochastic-parrot deflationism to proto-mind anthropomorphism, organized as a diagnostic taxonomy of six misconceptions.

entry.title: Provable Edge-of-Stability for Adam on a One-Dimensional Quadratic

author.name: Yiman Fong, Heng Yang

entry.summary: Provable analysis of uncorrected Adam on one-dimensional quadratics characterizes edge-of-stability dynamics, proving a restoring tendency toward the frozen stability threshold in broad regimes and identifying breakdown settings including subcritical periodic orbits and supercritical convergence paths.

entry.title: C-Score: Beyond Accuracy for Robustness Assessment in Semi-Supervised Learning under Open-World Unlabeled Contamination

author.name: Tsao-Lun Chen, Chi-Cheng Fu, Han-Yi E. Chou, Shun-Feng Su

entry.summary: C-Score detects hidden collapse in pseudo-label semi-supervised learning under open-world unlabeled contamination, where clean test accuracy can look stable while internal learning dynamics deteriorate because confident OOD samples enter training; it offers a robustness metric beyond accuracy.

entry.title: Temporal Validity on Real Software Histories: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors in Code-Assistant Memory over GitHub Fixes

author.name: Neeraj Yadav

entry.summary: Validating a deterministic supersession memory for RAG on 130 atomic state transitions extracted from 707 real GitHub issues, this work eliminates stale-fact errors where retrieval serves superseded values (renamed functions, moved endpoints) with near-identical similarity to current ones.

entry.title: Source-Free MT Evaluation Is Not MT Evaluation

author.name: Baban Gain, Ramakrishna Appicharla, Asif Ekbal

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that source-free reference-based machine translation evaluation is unfaithful to translation adequacy because references are only one possible rendering of the source. It advocates judging adequacy with respect to the source and treating references as auxiliary evidence.

entry.title: $Z^2$-ACT: End-to-End Verifiable Agentic Intent Control for Open 6G RAN

author.name: Sunder Ali Khowaja, Kapal Dev, George C. Alexandropoulos

entry.summary: Z-squared-ACT integrates zero-trust prompt verification, formal intent constraints, cryptographic accountability, and continuous semantic verification for safe AI-assisted control loops in disaggregated 6G radio access networks hosting multiple vendors. It unifies previously isolated safety mechanisms into one architecture.

entry.title: PromptResponse: Optimizing Prompts for LLM Coding Tasks

author.name: Erik Thureck, Robert K\"uhnen, Tim Jacobowitz

entry.summary: PromptResponse studies how prompt formatting affects LLM coding performance using five syntactic variants of HumanEval with GPT-4o over 8200 executions, finding consistent formatting especially JSON improves performance, efficiency, and stability. Results quantify a sensitivity often treated informally.

entry.title: DAMOS: Learning Distortion-Aware Speech Quality Assessment through Explicit Distortion Localization

author.name: Naiyuan Li, Li Dong, Diqun Yan

entry.summary: DAMOS learns distortion-aware speech quality assessment by adding explicit distortion localization as auxiliary supervision, motivated by synthetic speech distortions being locally concentrated and dominating perceptual quality. Utterance-level MOS alone provides too coarse a signal for where problems occur.

entry.title: Geometric Regularization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Learning via Gaussian Feature Bridges

author.name: Hongyang He, Xinyuan Song, Yan Zhong, Daizong Liu, Yanbin Li, Yang-fan He, Wenqiao Zhang

entry.summary: Gaussian Bridge Consistency addresses long-tailed semi-supervised learning by constructing class-conditional Gaussian feature bridges from unlabeled samples toward a dynamic Prototype Atlas of reliable anchors, letting students traverse smooth trajectories from uncertain predictions to confident classes and reducing pseudo-label confirmation bias.

entry.title: Exploratory As-Analyzed No-Detection of Culturally-Marked Predicate-Triggered PII Amplification in a Synthetic-English RAG Probe: A Predicate-Resource-Confounded Audit

author.name: Yanhang Li, Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang

entry.summary: A pre-registered four-culture audit asks whether stereotype-loaded queries leak more PII from RAG systems than neutral queries, defining the Stereotype-Trigger Leakage Delta metric. The authors candidly report that the confirmatory estimator was never run and the leakage metric was contaminated by prompt-echo artifacts, so all findings are exploratory. Documents methodological pitfalls in fairness-privacy auditing.

entry.title: On the Transferability of Agricultural Weed Detection Under Cross-Field Distribution Shift

author.name: Nikhilesh Prabhakar, Pranuthi Tenali, Wilfredo Abudeye Fernandez, Shekhar Borah, Athresh Karanam, Erik Blasch, Prabha Sundaravadivel, Sriraam Natarajan

entry.summary: Characterizes where UAV weed-detection performance degrades under cross-field and cross-crop distribution shift and which modeling choices recover it, introducing a newly annotated cotton-field UAV dataset. Prior work evaluates within a single field, leaving generalization unknown. Reduces relabeling burden for precision-agriculture deployments.

entry.title: Identify, Locate, Link: End-to-End Key-Value Extraction from Document Images

author.name: A. Said Gurbuz (IBM Research Zurich, ETH Zurich), Ahmed Nassar (IBM Research Zurich), Christoph Auer (IBM Research Zurich), Maksym Lysak (IBM Research Zurich), Lucas Morin (IBM Research Zurich), Matteo Omenetti (IBM Research Zurich), Tim Strohmeyer (IBM Research Zurich), Panagiotis Vagenas (IBM Research Zurich), Nikolaos Livathinos (IBM Research Zurich), Michele Dolfi (IBM Research Zurich), Peter Staar (IBM Research Zurich)

entry.summary: MigrationNarrate is the first multimodal dataset for detecting migration narratives in UK YouTube videos, comprising 1,115 videos annotated for narrative presence and type. Addresses the gap left by text-centric narrative detection as public discourse shifts to video platforms.

entry.title: TopoSurfel: Closing the Loop between Gaussian Surfels and Meshes for Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Chuanjin Fan, Wenjie Chang, Bohao Liao, Yujia Chen, Wenfei Yang, Tianzhu Zhang

entry.summary: TopoSurfel closes the loop between Gaussian surfels and continuous meshes for surface reconstruction from 3DGS, introducing structured geometric priors during optimization to resolve artifacts and floaters in textureless or occluded regions.

entry.title: Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation via Agentic Enhancement and Semantic Repair

author.name: Jiayi Gao, Changcheng Hua, Jiaqi Tang, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu

entry.summary: AESR is a lightweight agentic enhancement framework for identity-preserving text-to-video generation that improves prompt construction and applies semantic repair around closed-source black-box commercial video models, mitigating identity drift and instruction-following failures without parameter access.

entry.title: DiGS-Avatar: Single-Image Animatable 3D Human Reconstruction via UV-Space Diffusion

author.name: Jiakun Li, Li Fang, Hao Zhu, Fei Hu, Long Ye, Yuan Zhang, Jinyao Yan

entry.summary: DiGS-Avatar reformulates single-image animatable 3D human reconstruction as UV-latent completion, ensuring 3D consistency by design, with a teacher-student scheme where multi-view pseudo-ground-truth supervises a single-view diffusion student. Avoids costly multi-view synthesis stages.

entry.title: Enhancing Localized Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Efficient Segment-to-Video Supervision

author.name: Beibei Zhang, Chao Xu, Jun Lan, Zongyi Li, Lai Wei, Huijia Zhu, Tongwei Ren

entry.summary: Proposes efficient segment-to-video supervision to enhance localized reasoning in long video understanding, avoiding costly reinforcement fine-tuning frameworks and latency-inducing iterative perception mechanisms while still grounding answers in relevant evidence segments.

entry.title: Semantically Compatible Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Domain Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Qifeng Zhang, Ting Xiang, Zeyuan Bai, Changjian Chen

entry.summary: SLE-T is a semantically compatible knowledge-distillation framework for cross-domain object detection using vision foundation models, injecting pretrained local-texture priors into DINOv2 via a lightweight adapter to fix spatial-scale discrepancy and improve pseudo-label quality under domain shift.

entry.title: LHMCF-Net: A Learned Hyperbolic Mean Curvature Flow Network for Medical Images Segmentation

author.name: Shuangshuang Duan, Chunlei He, Shoujun Huang, Dexing Kong

entry.summary: LHMCF-Net integrates learned hyperbolic mean curvature flow, a second-order dissipative PDE with velocity-driven inertia, as a mathematical foundation fusing data fidelity and deep structural priors for medical image segmentation, helping contours bypass noise-induced local minima.

entry.title: Robust Validation to Geometric Perturbations for Autonomous Pose Estimation

author.name: Gregoire Theau, Melanie Ducoffe

entry.summary: Shows standard gradient-based spatial attacks fail on pose estimation robustness validation, often worse than random sampling, and reformulates the problem within Global Lipschitzian Optimization to produce rigorous worst-case bounds under geometric perturbations for safety-critical navigation.

entry.title: Gaussian-Mixture Latent Flow for Stochastic 3D Human Motion Prediction

author.name: Yue Ma, Frederick W. B. Li, Xiaohui Liang

entry.summary: Proposes a latent flow-based stochastic human motion prediction model with a data-driven Gaussian mixture prior disentangling diverse behaviors, enabling plausibility filtering and uncertainty quantification via invertibility, without extra annotations.

entry.title: ES-VP : Energy-Shaped Dynamic Visual Prompting for Efficient Model Adaptation

author.name: Can Jin, Ying Li, Jingchen Sun, Hongwu Peng, Jiahui Zhao, Yang Zhou, Lei Li, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: ES-VP generates image-specific visual prompts via energy-shaped optimization without auxiliary networks, balancing flexibility and parameter efficiency for adapting frozen pre-trained models, mitigating overfitting biases of prompt-generator approaches.

entry.title: Enabling Memory-efficient Im2win Convolution with Multi-precision Support on GPU CUDA and Tensor Cores

author.name: Xiang Fu, Jixiang Ma, Xinpeng Zhang, Peng Zhao, Shuai Lu, Xu Tony Liu

entry.summary: Extends the memory-efficient im2win convolution paradigm to CUDA cores and tensor cores with multi-precision support, adding zig-zag memory access and asynchronous data movement to improve cache utilization and numerical stability across kernel sizes.

entry.title: IMU-Free Body-Frame State Estimation with Sparse Scene Flow for Quadcopters

author.name: Daniel Gr{\o}nhaug, Sofie Markeset, Mathias Kolberg

entry.summary: Vision-only body-frame state estimation for quadcopters without IMUs, using stereo images and motor thrust commands within a continuous-discrete EKF on composite manifolds, treating stationary scene points as implicit inertial references.

entry.title: Scalable Distributed Simulation-Based Testing for Automated Driving Systems

author.name: Christian Geller, Benedikt Haas, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: The paper presents a DevOps-driven framework automating build, deployment, and distributed execution of thousands of CARLA-based scenario tests for automated driving systems on lightweight Kubernetes clusters, packaging ROS 2 applications as Helm charts and composing simulations declaratively via Helmfile manifests. It demonstrates how distributed simulation-based testing workflows can be operationalized end-to-end.

entry.title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator: Memory-Primed Agent Spawning for Personal AI Infrastructure

author.name: Myron Koch (Peak Summit Labs)
